raw.description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Customer Engineering team is the technical backbone of the pre- and post-sales customer motion. The team brings together work that has historically sat across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.

As a Senior Customer Engineer, you own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact extends beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team.

This is a remote role supporting a West Coast territory.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • New customer acquisition and selling: Partner with Account Directors on pre-sales motions for new customer acquisition, product expansion, and expansion across lines of business. You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops.
  • Complex implementations and value realization: Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time.
  • Adoption, expansion, and growth: Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.
  • Technical escalation: Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.
  • Team capability building: Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team.
  • Early account impact: Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.
  • Quarterly business outcomes: Drive measurable improvement in customer health, retention, expansion, and technical resolution across strategic accounts. You contribute reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that other Customer Engineers use and become a trusted advisor to Account Directors on account health and technical strategy.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Customer Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • 5 to 8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Engineering, implementation, professional services, or solutions architecture.
  • Deep hands-on experience with web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST APIs, with the ability to architect and troubleshoot complex front-end implementations.
  • Proven experience managing strategic Enterprise accounts with executive-level stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex technical or business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple variables, constraints, and tradeoffs.
  • Experience connecting technical execution to business outcomes such as retention, expansion, ROI, and value realization.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools for account research, content creation, or workflow automation, with demonstrated integration into day-to-day work rather than light experimentation.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching more junior technical team members.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Pendo, digital adoption platforms, product analytics, or in-app experience tooling in an enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile app development, including Swift, Android, or React Native.
  • Familiarity with data architecture, AI or machine learning concepts, or advanced analytics instrumentation.
  • Track record of building reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that were adopted by a broader team.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Remote

Compensation: The expected On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role is $193,393 - $241,742, with a 70/30 base-to-variable compensation split.

Benefits: Pendo offers highly competitive United States benefits, including employer-heavy coverage with $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. raw.description:
VAGA INTERNA – CONSTRUA SEU FUTURO NA ZUP!

Na Zup, acreditamos que o futuro é construído por pessoas que desafiam o presente. Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que transformam o mercado e elevam a experiência dos nossos clientes.

Valorizamos o crescimento contínuo dos Zuppers, incentivando cada pessoa a trilhar caminhos que impulsionem sua evolução profissional.

Por meio do Processo Seletivo Interno (PSI), você pode explorar novas tecnologias, projetos e oportunidades de carreira, em um processo transparente, acessível e alinhado aos seus objetivos.

Sobre o desafio no Projeto

Buscamos uma pessoa CSM (Customer Success Manager) para fortalecer a disciplina de Customer Success da StackSpot, nossa plataforma de engenharia agêntica. Você será responsável por conduzir a jornada dos clientes, desde o onboarding até a adoção e geração de valor, atuando de forma consultiva com clientes e stakeholders estratégicos. Além da gestão da carteira, a posição terá papel importante na identificação de oportunidades de expansão e na evolução da disciplina de Customer Success, contribuindo para a criação de processos, métricas e playbooks que aumentem a previsibilidade e o impacto da adoção da plataforma.

O que você irá fazer por aqui

  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos clientes, garantindo clareza sobre objetivos, marcos e resultados esperados;
  • Construir e acompanhar planos de sucesso conectados aos objetivos e casos de uso dos clientes;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva com lideranças e stakeholders estratégicos, influenciando decisões e promovendo alinhamento entre áreas;
  • Acompanhar adoção, engajamento, retenção e geração de valor, identificando riscos, bloqueios e oportunidades;
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas, apresentando indicadores, resultados, evolução e próximos passos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão e apoiar a evolução da adoção da StackSpot em novas áreas e iniciativas;
  • Atuar em parceria com Tech CSs, Produto e Engenharia, conectando necessidades dos clientes à evolução da plataforma;
  • Criar e evoluir playbooks, processos e métricas de Customer Success para ambientes enterprise;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e contribuir para o desenvolvimento da cultura de Customer Success na organização.

O que esperamos de você

  • Interesse em atuar como Customer Success Manager, se já tiver experiência será um forte diferencial;
  • Conhecimento na condução de onboarding de clientes, adoção de plataformas, retenção e expansão de clientes estratégicos;
  • Capacidade de estruturar planos de sucesso e conduzir relacionamentos com stakeholders e lideranças;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de Customer Success, como adoção, retenção, expansão e time-to-value;
  • Capacidade analítica para transformar dados de clientes em planos de ação orientados a resultados;
  • Comunicação consultiva, influência transversal e habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança;
  • Organização e autonomia para gerenciar múltiplos clientes, prioridades e iniciativas;
  • Proatividade, resiliência e adaptabilidade para atuar em cenários complexos e ambíguos.

O que seria legal se você tivesse

  • Experiência como Customer Success Manager em ambientes SaaS B2B, preferencialmente com clientes enterprise;
  • Experiência com plataformas de tecnologia, engenharia de software, DevOps ou transformação digital;
  • Vivência com clientes e stakeholders de áreas técnicas e de engenharia;
  • Experiência na criação e evolução de playbooks, frameworks e processos de Customer Success enterprise;
  • Experiência atuando em parceria com times de Produto e Engenharia;
  • Experiência contribuindo para o desenvolvimento ou formação de outros profissionais de Customer Success.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo Interno (PSI)

1. Validação da Aplicação

O time de Talent realiza a análise inicial, considerando os seguintes critérios:

  • Ser Zupper há pelo menos 3 meses;
  • Não ter participado de outro PSI nos últimos 3 meses;
  • Estar há mínimo de 3 meses no projeto atual.
  • Somente serão aceitas candidaturas de zuppers Z07.

2. Conversa com Talent

Momento para conversarmos sobre:

  • Sua motivação e expectativas com a movimentação;
  • Situação atual no projeto e eventuais dúvidas sobre o PSI;
  • Orientação sobre a comunicação com sua liderança direta.

Após a conversa, o Talent realiza a comunicação formal à liderança, informando o início do processo e, em caso de aprovação, conduz a negociação de liberação.

3. Entrevista e Avaliação Técnica

Para movimentações laterais, será realizado alinhamento de expectativas e validação dos desafios da nova função, considerando sua experiência em Customer Success, atuação consultiva, gestão de clientes e geração de valor.

4. Resultado Final e Transição

  • Comunicação dos resultados a todas as pessoas participantes;
  • Transição do Zupper aprovado para o novo projeto, em até 30 dias.

O que acontece após minha aplicação na vaga interna?

Confirmada sua candidatura e analisado que seu perfil faz sentido para a posição escolhida, comunicaremos via e-mail a liderança e BP imediatos sobre sua aplicação em seleção interna.

Quer entender mais sobre os detalhes, acesse a página de Vagas Internas na Zupnet.

raw.description:
THE HOKUS PLATFORM, an FNZ Company, is a digital B2B solution, developed in SaaS mode, that operates in the life insurance industry.

The SAAS platform (called THE HOKUS PLATFORM) connects wealth managers (private bankers, insurance brokers) and life insurance companies. This platform aims to be the daily tool for private bankers by dematerializing part of their activity related to the management of life insurance contracts

We also design, develop and maintain front-end and administration systems for life insurance companies. This team is currently developing systems for two major life insurancecompanies.

THE HOKUS PLATFORM currently operates from 4 countries: Luxembourg, France, Ireland and Spain.

How we do it?

Teamwork, listening and ambition are essentials keys in the development and success of our projects. Joining us means working in an international and multicultural team sharing common values:

- Client first. We put our clients first, our team second, our shareholders third.

- Radical Transparency. We make all choices in writing and adopt a direct and honest style of communication.

- We care about each other. We trust each other and believe competition is outside. Internal politic / internal competition has no value to Hokusians.

- Personal & Team Growth. We are self-improving whilst helping others grow. We’re no ego-doers and we all participate in building the company.

- Distributed Ownership. We trust our colleagues to make the right choices. We are not afraid to fail fast individually to learn collectively in the long run.

- Fearless ambition. We shoot for the moon and work backwards. We focus on solving complex problems with simple principles far from ready-made ideas.

The Software engineer responsibilities

Our growing Engineering team is looking for Software Engineers to help deliver the next generation of our platform.

If you are an IT passionate, love coding (in any object-oriented language) and finding solutions to complex problems, please reach out. Our multi-cultural team is eager to welcome new innovative persons.

  • Analyse, design and develop tests to build robust new features in an agile environment.

  • Provide ongoing maintenance, support and enhancements in existing and new systems and platforms.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, business users, project managers and other engineers to achieve elegant solutions.

  • Provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

  • Work alongside other engineers/scientists on the team to elevate technology and consistently apply best practices.

Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for engineers to help us scale our team from different perspectives (product, tech, and internal organization-wise):

- You’ll be able to participate into projects involving several engineers. Yes, you’ll have the opportunity to support other engineers.

- You'll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates' hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at The Hokus Platform if most of this sounds like you:

  • Experience working with Smalltalk or as software engineer for the life insurance sector is required.

  • Hands-on experience working with technologies.

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Team spirit

  • Experience with test-driven development and automated testing frameworks.

  • Experience with Scrum/Agile development methodologies.

  • Capable of delivering on multiple competing priorities with little supervision.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Master’s degree in engineering, PHD Degree in science or equivalent experience.

  • English fluent: working language.

  • French or Italian is a plus.



About FNZ


FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.


We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.


We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's business depends on navigating an evolving patchwork of state and local policy, and the Pacific Northwest is an active front in that landscape. Without dedicated, expert representation, key policymakers in the region lack a clear picture of how Instacart's platform benefits their constituents and the broader ecommerce ecosystem. This role exists to close that gap: building durable relationships with elected officials and stakeholders, shaping legislative and regulatory outcomes, and ensuring Instacart is never caught flat-footed by policy shifts. A year from now, the northwest region will have a well-developed advocate network, proactive campaign infrastructure, and a consistent voice at the table on the issues that matter most to the business.

This position covers the Pacific Northwest, and the ideal candidate will reside in AK, ID, MT, ND, OR, SD, or WA.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A robust policymaker relationship network is established across northwest state and local government, with clear coverage of key officials and influencers and the potential to expand into additional states based on demand.
  • Legislative, regulatory, and political strategies are crafted and executed to advance Instacart's state and local policy goals, including hearing preparation, testimony delivery, and regulatory proceeding participation.
  • A coalition of third-party political, advocacy, and industry allies is built and maintained to support strategic policy objectives, including active representation in trade associations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Policy Development, Legal, and Public Engagement teams results in integrated advocacy campaigns and coherent state and local policy solutions for key legislative priorities.
  • External consultant relationships and annual government affairs budgets are managed effectively, with regular reporting cadences and internal materials keeping cross-functional stakeholders informed of policy developments.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of state or local government, policy, or corporate government relations experience
  • Established policymaker relationships with confidence engaging elected officials and executives alike
  • Deep understanding of state and local lawmaking and regulatory processes
  • Strategic thinker with polished oral and written presentation skills
  • Proven ability to thrive under pressure, balancing long and short-term priorities to deliver results
  • Resourceful and entrepreneurial with a bias towards action, and willingness to travel frequently
  • Collaborative approach with a positive, can-do attitude, and adherence to internal rules and protocols for travel, expenses, budgeting, and tracking

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Expertise in labor/workforce, ecommerce, or tech policy
  • Experience with Slack

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

raw.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
raw.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
raw.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Kenya.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
  • Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.

Why Join Us

  • A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
  • Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
  • Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations. This position is responsible for monitoring active shipments from pickup through final delivery, maintaining accurate load information, communicating with carriers and drivers, and quickly identifying potential service issues. The Track & Trace Coordinator plays an important role in providing excellent customer service by ensuring our team always knows where each shipment is and whether it is operating according to schedule. This is a fast-paced position requiring strong communication, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

•Monitor active shipments from dispatch through final delivery.

•Contact carriers and drivers to obtain accurate pickup, transit, and delivery updates.

•Confirm drivers are on schedule for pickup and delivery appointments.

•Verify arrival and departure times at shippers and receivers.

•Update shipment status, notes, ETA information, and appointment details in the TMS.

•Identify late trucks, missed appointments, breakdowns, detention, rejected product, temperature issues, and other potential service failures.

•Immediately escalate significant service issues to the appropriate operations or sales team member.

•Proactively communicate delays rather than waiting for customers or internal team members to discover an issue.

•Maintain consistent communication with carriers until problems are resolved.

•Obtain and upload Bills of Lading, Proofs of Delivery, lumper receipts, and other required shipment documentation.

•Assist with scheduling and confirming pickup and delivery appointments as needed.

•Ensure completed loads contain the information and documentation necessary for billing.

•Maintain clear, professional, and accurate notes so another team member can quickly understand the status of any shipment.

•Assist Customer Sales and Carrier Sales representatives with operational support as needed.

Working conditions:

  • Work schedule:

    T&T #1

    • Monday–Tuesday: 11 PM–7 AM CST

    • Wednesday–Thursday: Days off

    • Friday–Sunday: 11 PM–7 AM CST

    • 1-hour unpaid lunch break during each shift

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Remote mode of work

  • 10+ business days of paid time off

  • Team building and corporate events

  • Equipment provided

  • A supportive team

Requirements

  • Extremely dependable with strong follow-through.

  • Detail-oriented and organized.

  • Comfortable making frequent phone calls, sending emails, and communicating by text.

  • Able to manage a high volume of shipments without losing track of details.

  • Strong sense of urgency when something is going wrong.

  • Able to recognize potential problems before they become customer service failures.

  • Comfortable working independently and making decisions within established procedures.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Able to remain professional when dealing with frustrated drivers, carriers, customers, or facilities.

  • Experience in freight brokerage, trucking, transportation, dispatch, or logistics is preferred but not required.

  • Experience with a Transportation Management System (TMS) is preferred.

    What Success Looks Like

  • A successful Track & Trace Coordinator doesn't simply enter updates into the system. They own shipment visibility.

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Strong analytical and decision-making capability

Excellent Board and stakeholder communication

Results-driven and financially disciplined

Transformational and innovation-oriented

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

SI-BONE is seeking a Field Operations Specialist to support our global fulfillment operations, helping ensure reliable support for surgical procedures through efficient, compliant, and timely delivery of medical products and assets. This role supports day-to-day fulfillment, asset and loaner kit management, and field inventory activity across both commercial and clinical channels.

This individual will work closely with field teams, warehousing and logistics partners, and internal stakeholders to keep orders moving and assets available. SI-BONE is seeking a Field Operations Specialist to support our global fulfillment operations, helping ensure reliable support for surgical procedures through efficient, compliant, and timely delivery of medical products and assets. This role supports day-to-day fulfillment, asset and loaner kit management, and field inventory activity across both commercial and clinical channels.

This individual will work closely with field teams, warehousing and logistics partners, and internal stakeholders to keep orders moving and assets available. Fulfillment and Inventory Operations

Reverse Logistics and Asset Recovery

  • Execute and help improve reverse logistics workflows to ensure prompt and traceable returns of borrowed and loaner assets.
  • Partner with field teams and 3PLs to reduce turnaround time and increase asset availability.

Loaner Program Management

  • Support planning and execution of the loaner kit program, ensuring geographic alignment and procedural readiness.
  • Track kit utilization and idle time, and surface opportunities to improve kit availability.

Loose Inventory and Ad Hoc Support

  • Maintain rigorous inventory accuracy for non-kitted implants and consumables.

Customer and Field Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for field sales, clinical teams, and customer service on product delivery and availability, escalating complex issues as needed.
  • Support customer-facing order fulfillment communications and reporting.

Process Improvement and Compliance

  • Identify and support continuous improvement opportunities across fulfillment and asset operations.
  • Perform all work in alignment with quality system requirements and regulatory standards (FDA, ISO, EU MDR).
  • Support internal and external audits as needed.

Supplemental pay: bonus and stock

raw.description:
This internship is designed for a college student who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working behind the scenes to keep a professional services firm running smoothly. This role is administratively heavy and will support recruiting, operations, sales, and marketing efforts. You will work closely with recruiters and firm leadership and will be trusted with time-sensitive, confidential work.

Duration: October 2026 to January 2027

Pay: $16 per hour

Location: Must live in Wisconsin

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Administrative Support

  • Schedule phone and on-site interviews using Outlook and shared calendars
  • Conduct initial phone screens using a structured template and accurately document notes
  • Manage candidate communication, follow-ups, and scheduling logistics
  • Update and maintain applicant tracking systems and internal recruiting databases
  • Post job openings and manage job-related documentation

Operations & Technical Support

  • Manage shared folders, documents, and internal files
  • Assist with data entry, reporting, projects, and internal process documentation
  • Support recruiters across multiple client projects with administrative tasks
  • Maintain organization and accuracy across multiple systems and tools

Marketing & Research Support

  • Assist with basic marketing tasks such as updating content, organizing materials, and light research
  • Support sales and marketing initiatives through research, list building, or data cleanup
  • Help maintain consistency across documents, templates, and materials

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in college (Business, Marketing, Communications, HR, or related field preferred)
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills with high attention to detail
  • Comfortable on the phone and interacting professionally with candidates and internal teams
  • Strong technical skills with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Interested in learning more about recruiting
  • Experience or coursework in marketing, marketing tools, and content strongly preferred
  • Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines without constant supervision
  • Professional demeanor and strong business judgment
  • Must be able to handle confidential information responsibly

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience supporting real client work in a professional consulting environment
  • Exposure to recruiting operations, systems, and workflows
  • Training, guidance, and hands-on work sourcing and recruiting candidates
  • Practical administrative, technical, and organizational experience employers actually value
  • Direct mentorship and feedback from experienced professionals

The Panaro Group is a woman-owned recruiting consulting firm based in Pewaukee, Wisconsin. We partner with organizations to solve complex hiring challenges and make confident decisions about their talent needs. Our experienced team provides customized recruiting solutions while building lasting relationships with our clients and candidates. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through clarity, integrity, and genuine humanity for connecting great people with great organizations.

title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison
description: Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders.

raw.title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison
raw.excerpt: Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders.
raw.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI). Rezolute’s mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity. 

The Sr Medical Science Liaison (Sr MSL) are responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with medical thought leaders within the metabolic and oncologic space. Sr MSLs provide medical information through scientific exchange, and clinical/scientific support for Rezolute and the Medical Affairs department. This work position requires professionals with established personal and scientific credibility to interact with global thought leaders and academic centers of excellence. The Sr MSL will represent Rezolute to the highest professional and ethical standards, in accordance with company guidelines, policies, and the mission and values of the Medical Affairs organization.

The Sr MSL position reports to Sr. Medical Director Endocrine Oncology

Essential Functions 

    KOL Development and Field Engagement: 

    • Identify, develop, and maintain peer-to-peer relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and healthcare providers within relevant Metabolic and Oncology therapeutic areas 

    • Identify new, up and coming thought leaders within target therapeutic areas 

    • Develop and execute projects and program material in alignment with evolving launch readiness plans 

    • Identify and communicate key clinical and research issues and insights from KOLs to appropriate departments 

    • Capture, analyze, and report field-based medical and scientific insights in a structured and compliant manner to inform Rezolute’s strategic decision-making 

    • Participate in medical education for healthcare professionals (HCPs) through virtual/on-site presentations at healthcare institutions, investigator meetings, national/international conferences, advisory boards, or regional meetings 

    • Provide scientific support for additional activities such as medical congress staffing, advisory boards, and internal and external training initiatives 

    • Respond to unsolicited medical information requests from healthcare professionals in a timely, accurate, and balanced manner 

    • Support other Medical Affairs activities and responsibilities as assigned

     
    Positions self as Scientific Expert 

    • Maintains an up to date and high-level knowledge of the therapy area, Rezolute products, new and emerging areas of research, therapeutic issues and trends, and competitive landscape. 

    • Establishes reputation as a trustworthy and knowledgeable source of scientific and medical information for the healthcare community. 

    • Supports development of Rezolute positioning as the scientific authority in Metabolism & Oncology therapeutic space. Attends appropriate scientific congresses to stay abreast of developments and to support International, National, Regional and local KOL activities and Rezolute interests. 

    • Acquires a broad understanding of local, national and international protocols and standards of clinical practice and trends in disease management. 

    • Provide clinical presentations and information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic, community, and healthcare provider settings in both group and one-on-one situations 

    • Communicates emerging data and the clinical experience with our products through scientific exchange and peer-to-peer interactions discussing benefits and risks in an objective manner. 

    • Provide support for data generation activities (company-sponsored studies, collaboration studies, ISTs and Rezolute’s Expanded Access Program) 

    • Critically evaluate emerging scientific literature and evidence to provide evidence-based insights that inform internal strategy and external engagement. 

    • Proactively identify and communicate potential publication opportunities arising from scientific exchange, field insights from interaction with external experts, data gaps, and analysis of the evolving literature

     

    Medical Affairs Planning and Plan Execution 

    • Contributes to the development of the launch readiness plans and provides input into strategies and tactics. 

    • Strong business acumen and understanding of cross-functional processes across research, clinical development, regulatory, and commercial functions.” 

    • Works in a collaborative manner with cross-functional colleagues to meet defined strategic imperatives and critical success factors of commercial launch of Rezolute product(s). 

    • Interacts with HCPs as a scientific resource to support activities aligned with launch readiness plans including advisory boards, speaker development, data generation and publication plans and clinical trials, as appropriate. 

     

    Responsible for maintaining Company standards and values 

    • Consistently acts to enhance Rezolute’s image as an advocate of medical advancement by using knowledge of product, disease state and pipeline products to engage healthcare providers in meaningful scientific exchange of information. 

    • Document and forward reports of adverse events and product complaints according to Rezolute's policy to ensure safe and effective use of Rezolute’s products. 

    • Adheres to the relevant international, national and local Codes of Practice. 

    • Behaves ethically and with integrity at all times. 

    • Acts as an ambassador for Rezolute following company mission and values. 

    • Keeps own written development plan and implements. 

    • Prepares timely reporting according to the company needs. 

     

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

    • Ability to research, critically analyze and communicate complex scientific/medical information and data. 

    • Clear and concise communication and presentation skills. 

    • Excellent planning and organization skills, with high-level attention to detail and accuracy. 

    • Strong strategic mindset. 

    • Highly self-motivated and ability to work autonomously. 

    • Ability to learn quickly, be flexible and results-focused in a rapidly changing environment. 

    • Demonstrated skills in inter-personal relationship building, networking, collaboration and teamwork. 

    • Strong capabilities working with Microsoft suite of products and other digital platforms and tools are required 

    • Excellent command of spoken and written English. 

    • Ability and willingness to travel. Driving may be required. 

    • Knowledge of healthcare environment and external experts in academia and medical community. 

    • Demonstrated ability to develop trust and relationships with opinion leaders in disease states of interest. 

    • Understanding of regulatory requirements for field-based personnel 

    • Experience as a Medical Science Liaison with a strong track record of success is strongly preferred 

     

    Required Education and Licenses 

    • Advanced medical, clinical, or similar degree (such as MD, PhD, PharmD, , PA or equivalent)  

    • A minimum of 5 years' experience as a MSL or comparable industry or clinical role is required, with a minimum of 2 years’ experience in rare disease. 

    • This position will require field activities, and applicants must be willing to travel 60-75% time 

    • Valid driver's license and live within 60 miles of an airport services by at least one major airline. 

     
    Description of Physical Demands 

    • Frequent travel (domestic and international) with potential extended time away from home. 

    • Frequently operating a computer, printer, telephone and other similar office machinery. 

    • Responsibilities may require a work schedule that may include working outside of "normal" work hours, in order to meet business demands. 

    • Frequent public contact requiring appropriate business apparel. 

    Preferred Experience, Special Skills and Knowledge 

    We are looking for a candidate that has: 

  • Strong leadership skills and ability to effectively communicate up, down and across the organization 
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and deliver high-quality results on tight timelines 
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills including the ability to devise and implement practical solutions to resolve complex issues 
  • Excellent English written, verbal communication and presentation skills 
  • Knowledge of an additional language is desirable
  • Act with HONOR:  Honesty, Open with Direct Communication, Nimbleness, Open-minded, Respect 

ezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Sr Medical Science Liaison role could range from $200,000 to $240,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.  

 

  • Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as: 
  • Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision) 
  • Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance 
  • Holiday Pay 
  • Tracking Free Vacation Program 
  • 401(k) Plan Match 
  • Educational Assistance Benefit 
  • Fitness Center Reimbursement 

 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

raw.excerpt: Position SummaryAre you passionate about clinical documentation, risk adjustment, and improving the quality of patient care?
raw.description:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about clinical documentation, risk adjustment, and improving the quality of patient care? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and quality of clinical documentation across our organization.

If you're a collaborative problem solver with a strong background in Medicare and Medicaid Risk Adjustment, HCC Coding, Clinical Documentation Improvement, and provider education, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Clinical Documentation Improvement & Risk Adjustment

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on ICD-10-CM Coding Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and Risk Adjustment methodologies.
  • Conduct proactive medical record reviews to evaluate documentation quality, diagnosis coding accuracy, co-morbidities, complications, and appropriate secondary diagnoses.
  • Ensure patient conditions are accurately documented and coded to support quality care and appropriate risk stratification.
  • Identify documentation and coding trends impacting patient risk scores and value-based care performance.

Provider Education & Training

  • Develop and deliver engaging education programs for providers, coders, and clinical care teams.
  • Provide ongoing guidance on documentation best practices, coding updates, compliance requirements, and risk adjustment principles.
  • Create educational tools, resources, and training materials that improve coding accuracy and documentation quality.
  • Partner with providers to identify opportunities for documentation improvement and workflow optimization.

Value-Based Care & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate with contracted health plans on risk adjustment and value-based care initiatives.
  • Support auditing activities, review health plan findings, and develop performance improvement plans when needed.
  • Participate in clinical quality, revenue cycle, population health, and data analytics initiatives.
  • Monitor regulatory, coding, and reimbursement changes and communicate impacts across the organization.

Data Analysis & Collaboration

  • Analyze documentation and coding trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with clinical leadership, coding teams, health plans, and operational stakeholders.
  • Help drive strategies that improve quality scores, risk adjustment accuracy, and overall organizational performance.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Certified Risk Coder (CRC) through AAPC or CDI/CCS certification through AHIMA.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Medicare and/or Medicaid Risk Adjustment, including HHS-HCC, CMS-HCC, or DxCG methodologies.
  • Strong experience with ICD-10 coding and clinical documentation review.
  • In-depth knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and disease processes.
  • Expertise in HCC coding and risk adjustment programs.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to educate audiences at all levels.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current RN license in good standing.
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) through AAPC.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience, preferably in a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) or primary care environment.
  • Experience with Epic Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
  • Experience supporting value-based care and population health initiatives.

Why Join Us?

At our organization, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care while supporting a mission focused on improving community health. Your expertise will help ensure providers have the tools and knowledge needed to deliver high-quality, value-based care to the populations we serve.

What We Offer

100% Remote Work – Work from anywhere within the United States.

100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance – Comprehensive medical coverage at no cost to employees on one of our health plans.

Annual $1,500 HSA Contribution – Additional support to help manage healthcare expenses.

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and maintain work-life balance.

403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Contribution – Invest in your future with retirement savings support.

Professional Development & Education Assistance – Grow your skills through ongoing learning, certifications, and educational opportunities.

Mission-Driven Culture – Join a team dedicated to strengthening community health and expanding access to quality healthcare services.

raw.description:
We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Account Manager, Developer Relations to join our team, with a focus on engaging software companies and developer ecosystems across emerging technology domains. In this pivotal role, you will work directly with a small, strategic set of software solution providers (and their developers) to champion the adoption of NVIDIA’s advanced AI and computing platforms. Your mission is to partner with software companies to build AI agent-powered tools and integrate AI into their products making use of the NVIDIA platform, including open models and software frameworks and libraries.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep technical expertise, experience in technical account management, and combines these with a passion for developer advocacy, business development and a talent for communicating how NVIDIA technology can solve complex, real-world challenges.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Establish relationships (both technical and business) at every level with a small set of strategic, regionally important software companies, and develop and implement a strategy to integrate the NVIDIA platform into these companies products.

  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in agentic AI systems, open models, data science applications, and GPU-accelerated computing. Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for developers within the software companies you support. Collaborate with multi-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.

  • Accelerate critical software company workloads by demonstrating and integrating the NVIDIA software stack (tools, libraries, SDKs, open models, NIMs, and blueprints) into partner products, platforms, and pipelines.

  • Guide partners through onboarding and integration by providing technical resources—such as sample code, guides, and demo pipelines—to accelerate software companyadoption and foster co-innovation of next-generation solutions.

  • Map and supervise the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, collaborating with engineering, product management, and marketing to advise roadmaps and optimize partner adoption strategies.

  • Engage partner technical leaders to drive best-practice integrations and resolve technical challenges, using regular syncs to supervise adoption, surface new workflows, and channel critical field insights back to NVIDIA product teams.

  • Ability to travel frequently up to 60% of the time.

  • Communicate the business and commercial value of integrating the NVIDIA platform into software company’s products.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • A minimum of 8+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, product management, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in engaging with Product and Engineering organizations at enterprise-scale software companies on strategic product integrations.

  • Proven experience leading, partnering, scaling developer programs at major technology companies, and working on product integration with vertical-specific technology platforms or horizontal business applications.

  • Significant technical depth in AI/ML, customization of open models, or creation of agentic systems and contributions to product integrations and software libraries.

  • Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams - including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops

  • Proven track record to structure and implement sophisticated technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external collaborators (across sales, legal, product or marketing teams as needed).

  • Skilled at distilling complex technical concepts for audiences from engineers to executives, with end-to-end experience in defining, integrating, building, and jointly marketing solutions with strategic ISV partners.

  • Ability to conceptualize and communicate the commercial impact of integration of NVIDIA’s platform.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing AI solutions with software companies developing industry-specific technology systems or broad business software applications.

  • Outstanding capability to clarify complex technical concepts and communicate value to audiences, including AI/ML Engineers and C-suite executives. You have complete experience outlining, combining, developing, and delivering solutions with strategic ISV partners.

  • Familiarity with advanced computing, AI, and/or GPU acceleration platforms including agentic systems that incorporate domain-adapted, open models.

  • Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs.

  • Expertise in building frameworks to capture developer sentiment and market shifts, translating real-time ecosystem dynamics into actionable intelligence for industry strategy and product rationalization.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

We're hiring an AEO Specialist/Lead to own the execution layer of that program: living in the AI-visibility data every day, translating it into clear insight and priorities, and quarterbacking the cross-functional work — content, site/product, PR and affiliate, and dev — required to defend and extend Thorne's lead.
This role partners closely with our SEO/AEO agency, on strategy and roadmap definition, and works day-to-day with our Sr. Director of Ecommerce, content, product, and PR teams to turn that strategy into shipped work. This person will report to the VP of Growth Marketing.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Daily AI Visibility Analysis & Insights
  • Monitor Thorne's AI visibility, share of voice, average position, sentiment, and citation performance daily in Profound.
  • Flag competitive movement and emerging negative sources before they erode rankings or sentiment.
  • Distill Profound data into clear, actionable insights and recurring readouts for the VP of Growth and broader stakeholders.
Roadmap Ownership & Agency Collaboration
  • Own and maintain the AEO/AI-visibility roadmap, translating Croud's strategic recommendations into a prioritized, resourced execution plan.
  • Partner with Croud on quarterly strategy, topic prioritization (Defend / Grow / Repair / Build), and measurement — this person helps define the strategy, not just execute it.
  • Relentlessly prioritize the backlog based on business impact, competitive pressure, and available resourcing.
Cross-Functional Execution — the Quarterback Role
  • Project-manage AEO initiatives across every key channel + channel owner: content/blog, site/ecommerce, and PR / media affiliate.
  • Partner directly with Product and Dev to scope, prioritize, and track AEO-related tickets (crawlability, structured data, PDP fixes) through a backlog with significant competing demand.
  • Apply the repeatable citation model across owned and editorial (for credible third-party validation)
AI-Native / Marketing Engineering Mindset (a plus)
  • Bring a builder's instinct to the role — spot manual, repetitive AEO work (data pulls, competitive tracking, content briefs) and use AI tools or lightweight automation to remove it.
  • Where there's appetite, extend that same AI-native approach to other growth marketing workflows across the broader team.

WHAT YOU NEED

Required
  • 3–5+ years in a technical or analytical marketing role (SEO, growth, content ops, or similar) — or a clear track record of being AI-native even without traditional tenure.
  • Hands-on SEO experience and a working understanding of how SEO and AEO/GEO overlap and diverge.
  • Comfort working in AI-visibility or analytics platforms (Profound or similar); able to turn raw data into a clear narrative and prioritized action plan.
  • Demonstrated project management / quarterback experience — able to rally and hold accountable stakeholders across content, product, dev, PR, and agency partners without formal authority over them.
  • Comfortable operating in a complex environment with a dev backlog and competing priorities; prioritizes relentlessly.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools and workflows, with interest in applying them to scale marketing execution.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with digital PR or earned-media citation building.
  • Familiarity with ecommerce PDP/PLP optimization.
  • Prior experience managing an SEO/content agency relationship (agency- or client-side).
  • DTC, health, wellness, or CPG category experience.

This role is centred on leading and growing major client engagements. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, shape strategic solutions to complex infrastructure and asset management challenges, and build long-term relationships that deliver value for both our clients and AMCL.

Alongside leading delivery, you'll play a key role in the growth of our Transport business. Using your sector experience, industry profile and professional network, you'll identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships, develop new accounts and help shape the future direction of our Transport practice.

We are looking for someone who combines exceptional consulting and delivery leadership with the ability to build trusted executive-level relationships, develop people and contribute to sustainable business growth.

raw.title: Counsel, IP Litigation & Enforcement
raw.excerpt: About IP House At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property – both online and offline – across the globe.
raw.description:
About IP House

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property – both online and offline – across the globe. Through cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of trademark, copyright, and patent processes, we deliver scalable solutions for portfolio management, enforcement, and brand integrity. Our enforcement, investigations, revenue recovery, and compliance response practices sit at the center of that mission – disrupting counterfeiting, piracy, and illicit trade for some of the world’s most recognized brands, in partnership with government and law enforcement agencies around the world.

Overview of the Role:

This is a global role. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Counsel, IP Litigation & Enforcement serves as a core legal resource to IP House’s investigations, enforcement, and compliance response functions worldwide.

The role is built for breadth. In a given week, Counsel may advise an enforcement team on whether a matter is properly actionable, help assemble a criminal referral package alongside investigators and a client, work with outside counsel on a client’s filed civil action, and advise on legal process routed through our Compliance Response Solutions team. Matters span multiple jurisdictions and legal traditions, so the role suits a self-starter who manages many concurrent matters with precision, holds firm to deadlines across time zones, and can render a complex legal position into plain language that non-lawyers can act on immediately.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

IP Investigation & Enforcement Counseling

  • Serve as the day-to-day “go-to” legal resource for the IP investigation and enforcement teams, both online and offline.
  • Establish, document, and maintain investigation and enforcement legal standards, decision criteria, and escalation thresholds that work across jurisdictions, and provide the training and written guidance that lets teams resolve routine questions on their own.
  • Advise on evidence sufficiency, collection methodology, documentation, and chain-of-custody so that work product withstands scrutiny in civil, criminal, administrative, and customs forums.
  • Identify where local law materially changes the analysis and instruct local counsel to close the gap; escalate elevated legal, regulatory, or reputational risk to the COO with a decision-ready recommendation.

IP Litigation, Escalation & Referrals

  • Partner with the investigations and enforcement teams and with clients to assess matters for escalation to civil litigation, criminal referral, private prosecution where available, or administrative and customs action.
  • Support client’s civil IP litigation through its lifecycle alongside their designated outside and local counsel — including pre-suit assessment, review of pleadings and submissions as it relates to IP House involvement, discovery and disclosure support, and instances where IP House employees or affiliates act as an expert witness.
  • Support preparation of referral packages for law enforcement agencies and prosecuting authorities, including factual chronologies, legal theories, loss framing, and evidentiary indices.
  • Act as a legal point of coordination with law enforcement, prosecuting authorities, customs and border agencies, regulators, and platform partners, and advise on cross-border evidence gathering and third-party disclosure tools.
  • Track escalated matters through disposition, manage instructed counsel on scope, budget, and timeline, and counsel client-facing teams on realistic outcomes and timelines.

Revenue Recovery

  • Act as the primary legal liaison for the Revenue Recovery team.
  • Work with the Revenue Recovery team to ensure processes, evidentiary standards, and declarations confirm with legal requirements.
  • In consultation with outside counsel, advise internally on claim and evidence viability, limitation periods, jurisdiction and governing law, and collectability, and help standardize internal revenue recovery templates and workflows to ensure legal sufficiency.

Compliance Response Solutions

  • Act as the primary legal liaison for the Compliance Response Solutions team.
  • Provide the legal layer over the Compliance Response Solutions team’s review, triage, and fulfillment of Emergency Disclosure Requests, exigent requests, subpoenas, search warrants, court orders, and other notices.
  • Serve as the legal escalation point for out-of-compliance, ambiguous, or novel requests — advising on scope, validity, and jurisdictional reach, and on preservation, disclosure, and rejection decisions — in coordination with client legal, trust and safety, and law enforcement response teams.
  • Help maintain playbooks, escalation paths, and recordkeeping that satisfy multiple regulatory regimes and support client Service Level Agreements.

Compliance with IP House Standards & Applicable Law

  • Ensure that investigative and enforcement activity is conducted in compliance with IP House’s policies, procedures, and protocols, and with applicable law in every jurisdiction in which the company operates.
  • Advise on the lawfulness of investigative methods and enforcement tactics — evidence collection and handling, online investigation and monitoring techniques, test purchases, engagement with third parties and subjects, investigator licensing, and personal data handling — and set clear boundaries where the law or company protocol requires them.
  • Working with the COO and the Counsel, Contracts & Compliance, execute upon and enforce IP House’s legal compliance requirements and standards; monitor adherence across global enforcement and investigations operations, investigate deviations, and confirm remediation.
  • Deliver and administer legal compliance education for investigations, enforcement, and compliance response personnel, and maintain the guidance, templates, and knowledge resources the business relies on.

What You’ll Bring:

Required

  • Qualified lawyer in good standing, admitted or otherwise entitled to practice in the United Kingdom, an EU member state, or a United States jurisdiction — for example a solicitor or barrister of England & Wales, Scotland, or Northern Ireland; an equivalently qualified lawyer in an EU member state; or a JD holder admitted to a US state bar.
  • 3–5 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) gained in private practice, an in-house legal department, a government agency, or a prosecuting authority.
  • Based in, and holding the unrestricted right to work in, the United Kingdom or the United States.
  • Proven ability to carry a high volume of concurrent matters against firm deadlines with extreme attention to detail, working comfortably across time zones and jurisdictions.
  • Ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, plain-language guidance that non-lawyer operations, investigations, and client-facing teams can act on, with excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Self-starter with sound judgment: sets priorities, drives matters to closure, makes defensible recommendations on incomplete information, and exercises discretion with confidential, privileged, and sensitive material relating to active investigations and legal matters.

Highly Desired

Substantive background in IP enforcement — anti-counterfeiting, anti-piracy, trademark and copyright enforcement, marketplace and digital takedowns, illicit trade, or brand protection.

Desired

  • Prior work with law enforcement agencies and prosecutors, including developing or supporting criminal referrals, or prior service in a prosecutorial, police, customs, agency, or task-force role.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional services environment; additional language capability beyond English is welcome.

Location, Travel & Working Pattern

This globally scoped role is open to candidates based anywhere in the United Kingdom or the United States, working fully remotely or on a hybrid basis from one of our UK or US offices. Some flexibility in working hours is expected to accommodate colleagues, clients, and agencies in other time zones, together with availability for urgent escalations outside standard business hours. Occasional domestic or international travel may be required.

Why IP House:

Global Mission — help the world’s top brands protect their most valuable assets across every major market.

Genuinely Global Work — a single remit spanning US, UK, EU, and wider international enforcement, rather than one country’s docket.

Real Scope, Early — own enforceability calls and escalation decisions that move matters, with direct access to the COO and the executive team.

Senior Mentorship — learn directly from a COO who is a qualified lawyer with 25+ years of law firm and in-house experience, alongside seasoned law enforcement professionals and online and field investigators.

High Growth — join a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results, and room to grow with it.

Compensation

Salary Range: US: $110k -140k USD (depending on experience and qualifications), plus bonus;

UK: £70k-90k GBP (depending on experience and qualifications), plus bonus;

Classification: Full-time, permanent (exempt where applicable)

Base salary is benchmarked to the market in which the successful candidate is based and reflects their experience, qualifications, and location. Base salary and bonus are supplemented by a comprehensive local benefits package.

Equal Opportunity

IP House seeks excellence through diversity in its staff. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process.
