raw.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
raw.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
raw.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Spain

Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
  • Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.

Why Join Us

  • A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
  • Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
  • Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

•Leads the clear and accurate completion of medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.

•Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.

•Interacts and builds good working relations with clients, department head, and peers in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs, as necessary, to produce writing deliverables.

May contribute to development of internal materials and presentations or changes to internal process, standard practices, and capabilities.

•Mentors and leads less experienced medical writers on complex projects, as necessary.

•Develops deep expertise on key topics in the industry and the regulatory requirements and guidelines that affect medical writing.

•Aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, working within the budgeted hours and communicating status and changes to medical writing leadership.

•Completes required administrative tasks within the specified timeframes.

•Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

•Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of lead regulatory writing experience
  • Lead writing experience must have
  • Experience with Phase 2 and 3.
  • Lead writer experience with protocols, submissions, clinical Summary of Safety (CTD) Modules 2.7.3 and 2.7.4, CSRs (Clinical Study Reports), IBs (Investigator Brochure), Patient Narratives, Safety Aggregate Reports (plus), Briefing books, ISE and ISS (Integrated Summary Efficacy and Integrated Summary Safety).
  • Strong project management skills
  • Strong client experience
  • Time management skills a must
  • Process experience is a huge plus
  • Remote – Open to US, UK and Canada

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

$80,600.00 - $175,700.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

As a Principal Platform Architect (Principal) for Kainos, you'll be accountable for leading the delivery of cloud platforms and solutions enabling business transformation which delight our customers and positively impact the lives of users worldwide. As a technologist you will be inquisitive and will embrace new technology.

You'll provide leadership as part of multi-disciplinary agile teams, building a shared understanding of the outcomes the solution must deliver, the technical landscape and the complexity surrounding you and your teams' designs to help teams make informed decisions.

You'll set technology direction for AI-Augmented platform delivery today future AI enabled delivery tomorrow, engaging senior customer stakeholders on AI strategy, governance and ROI, and shaping how Kainos's Platforms capability evolves with the technology.

All employees are expected to continuously develop their understanding of AI capabilities relevant to their role and actively seek opportunities to improve customer, business, and delivery outcomes through responsible application of AI, while operating within appropriate security, regulatory, commercial, and governance constraints.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Leading cloud platform delivery: You'll be accountable for delivering cloud platforms underpinning large-scale transformation (migration, modernisation and new build) at pace and quality.

  • Building stakeholder relationships: You'll foster and build relationships with senior stakeholders to establish architectural principles, strategic direction of platforms, including functional and non-functional needs.

  • Leading the Platforms capability: You'll play a leading role in the Kainos Platforms Capability, driving technology direction and advancement; you'll guide others in the capability to support their career journeys, and be supported in yours.

  • Acting as a technology ambassador: You'll collaborate with colleagues to establish development of blueprints and standards, foster customer relationships, contribute to account strategies and actively share subject-matter knowledge as an ambassador for Kainos.

  • Working AI-Augmented: You'll maintain an open and curious mindset towards AI, continually exploring how evolving capabilities can improve the way work is performed. You'll challenge existing practices, experiment responsibly with new approaches, and apply sound judgement to determine where AI delivers meaningful value, and where it does not. You'll balance innovation with pragmatism as you remain accountable for the results delivered.

Minimum (Essential) Requirements

  • Proven experience of leading the delivery of platforms underpinning large-scale cloud transformation (e.g. migration to cloud environments, modernisation of applications harnessing cloud, deployment of web-based applications).

  • Experience leading and making technology decisions including execution of delivery driving positive customer outcomes.

  • Experienced in building and fostering relationships with stakeholders including at executive and C-level senior stakeholders, translating technology information as appropriate to drive effective decision making.

  • Experience with public cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, GCP (spanning IaaS, PaaS and SaaS).

  • Demonstrated ability in managing, coaching and developing members of your team and wider community.

  • Demonstrable experience of successfully applying AI to improve outcomes, evolve ways of working and solve complex business or delivery challenges. Evidence of translating experimentation and learning into sustainable improvements, shaping the adoption of effective practices and adapting approaches as technology capabilities evolve.

Desirable

  • Have pro-actively developed business across an account with sales and account managers.

  • Experience in managing others, setting objectives, giving feedback and leading performance reviews.

  • Actively sharing thoughts and views on technology.

  • Experience of helping to bring challenging projects back on track.

  • Previous accountability in creation and promotion of new products or services to meet the organisational strategy.

  • Participation in technology communities.

  • Experience shaping organisational technology, delivery, or platform capabilities that improve developer experience, productivity, delivery outcomes, and customer value across portfolios, client groups, or business units.

  • An active interest in emerging trends shaping the future of software delivery and platform engineering, such as agentic delivery patterns.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

About LearnLux

LearnLux is the leading provider of workplace financial wellbeing, blending fiduciary digital planning with access to one-on-one guidance from Certified Financial Planner™️ professionals. Our award-winning program helps employees navigate critical financial decisions from budgeting and benefits elections to equity compensation, home buying, and retirement so they can feel confident about their money and focused at work. Advanced reporting helps our partners understand impact, driving outcomes like reduced financial stress, increased productivity, and improved retention.

We’re building LearnLux with intention. We move quickly, operate with a high bar for quality, and value people who take ownership of their work. If you’re energized by solving new problems, taking accountability, and pushing yourself to do your best work every day, you’ll find this a rewarding environment.

We’re a venture-backed company that has raised over $35M to date and is supported by experienced investors and long-term partners. We’re a growth-focused business building for scale, and we’re excited by the opportunities and challenges that come with that journey.

The Role

LearnLux is looking for a part time Certified Financial Planner® to join our fast growing team. Leveraging the LearnLux digital experience you will work directly with employees to provide them with unbiased, holistic financial guidance. Your extensive financial experience and client-first approach will help employees prepare for and accomplish their personal and financial goals.

This role is 100% remote within the US and reports to the Director of Financial Planning.

What you’ll do

  • Must be available to work various shifts from 8 AM - 11 PM ET Monday through Friday with a typical expectation, but not guarantee, of 5-15 hours per week
  • Meet and engage with clients remotely over video, chat and email to give guidance on topics like budgeting, student loans, retirement readiness, equity compensation, debt management and more
  • Advise on the LearnLux methodology to improve and respond to the changing financial environment
  • Participate in monthly team meetings to bring your subject matter expertise to improve the LearnLux digital experience
  • Become an expert on our client’s benefit plans so you can act as an extension of their team during open enrollment

You should bring

  • CFP® designation required
  • Passion for educating individuals to take control and invest in their financial future
  • Have the ability to perform several tasks concurrently, to prioritize work, and to take direction from multiple team members
  • Can demonstrate ability to take initiative and execute
  • Experience in multiple areas of personal Finance: Retirement, Equity Compensation, investments, budgeting, debt management, Student Loans, cash flow planning, digital currencies, estate planning, insurance and more

It would be great if you also

  • CPA, Enrolled Agent, or similar
  • Certification in Credit Counseling
  • Additional Certifications
  • Startup and/or Fintech experience
  • Bi-lingual (Spanish)
  • Experience creating presentations and presenting to large audiences virtually or in-person
  • Availability to work occasional evenings and Saturday
  • Ability to occasionally travel to on-site events

LearnLux is a fit for you if you

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy building in moments of change. We operate with urgency, and roles, priorities, and approaches evolve as we grow.
  • Like wearing multiple hats and helping define the path forward. At LearnLux, roles evolve as we grow, and employees often help create clarity, structure, and direction where it didn’t previously exist.
  • Take initiative and don’t wait to be asked. You see problems as opportunities and are comfortable stepping in to move work forward.
  • Are energized by ambiguity and willing to make decisions with imperfect information. We learn quickly by doing, and pace is a competitive advantage for us.
  • Enjoy being hands-on and owning work end to end. While strategic thinking matters, execution, follow-through, and accountability are what drive impact here.
  • Are motivated by high standards and continuous improvement. As we hit new milestones, we intentionally raise the bar on quality, ownership, and outcomes.
  • Value clear, frequent communication and collaboration. As a remote team, staying aligned through proactive communication is core to how we operate.

Closing

LearnLux strives to be an inclusive workplace and values learning from and engaging across different perspectives. Women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and members of other minority or marginalized groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

LearnLux is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against candidates on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Point Cis a National third-party administrator (TPA) with local market presence that delivers customized self-funded benefit programs. Our commitment and partnership means thinking beyond the typical solutions in the market – to do more for clients – and take them beyond the standard “Point A to Point B.” We have researched the most effective cost containment strategies and are driving down the cost of plans with innovative solutions such as, network and payment integrity, pharmacy benefits and care management. There are many companies with a mission. We are a mission with a company.

Point C is seeking a detail-oriented and highly motivated Staff Accountant to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Controller, this role will serve as a key member of the Accounting Department and play an essential role in maintaining the integrity of financial records, supporting custodial account operations, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal controls.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong accounting foundation, exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing cash activity, reconciliations, and client or custodial accounts. This position requires the ability to analyze financial transactions, maintain accurate accounting records, and collaborate closely with operations, client service, and management teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Prepare monthly reconciliations and analysis of custodial accounts, ensuring accurate recording of client assets, cash transactions, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and balances.

  • Monitor aged receivables, communicate professionally with clients on outstanding balances, and support collection efforts while maintaining positive client relationships.
  • Manage daily cash receipts, deposits, and custodial transaction totals, maintaining accurate records of all custodial cash movement.
  • Prepare and record bank and cash reconciliation entries, ensuring timely reconciliation of revenue, receivables, and custodial cash balances.
  • Monitor cash activity, assist with treasury management functions, and promptly investigate unusual transactions or variances.
  • Participate in internal audits, compliance reviews, and process improvement initiatives to strengthen financial controls over custodial funds and client assets.
  • Partner with operations, client service, and management teams to resolve accounting issues and improve financial processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate or streamline accounting and reconciliation procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, financial institutions, auditors, and external vendors.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 2+ years of accounting experience, preferably involving cash management, reconciliations, or custodial/client account administration.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to maintaining confidential information.
  • Experience with general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, and financial reporting (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of cash reconciliation and treasury management activities (preferred).
  • Ability to work independently while contributing as a collaborative team member (preferred).
  • Experience working with custodial accounts, trust accounts, escrow accounts, client funds, or similar financial structures (preferred).
  • Knowledge of financial services, asset management, trust operations, or custody-related accounting practices (preferred).
  • Experience with Sage Intacct (preferred but not required).

Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

$45,000—$50,000 USD

About the Role

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms.

Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital.

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability.

Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management.

Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization.

Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning.

Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion.

Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions.

Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives.

Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders.

Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee.

Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization.

Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy.

Strategic KPIs

Group revenue and earnings growth

EBITDA / operating profit

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Insurance underwriting profitability

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Liquidity and treasury performance

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

M&A and strategic investment returns

Regulatory and audit performance

Finance transformation and automation

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

OVERVIEW:

Our Special Authorization Analyst II team is growing. This position plays a critical clinical decision-making role in assessing Special Authorization requests and determining appropriate medication coverage within established standards. Special Authorization is a process where prescribers can request coverage for specific drugs for their patients, and this role requires clinicians to apply evidence-based guidelines, clinical judgment, and a strong understanding of member needs to support timely access to medications.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Apply clinical expertise to assess Special Authorization requests, determine eligibility for requested drug therapies, and make decisions that directly impact member access to medications.
  • Interpret clinical information, accepted medical conditions, and plan criteria to ensure decisions are accurate, consistent, and clearly documented.
  • Record decision rationale and required information in Alberta Blue Cross® computer systems to support appropriate claims adjudication and continuity of member access.
  • Prepare clear, clinically informed correspondence for prescribers and subscribers regarding Special Authorization decisions.
  • Respond to electronic and telephone inquiries from internal and external customers by explaining decision outcomes, requirements, and next steps in a professional and member-focused manner.
  • The ability to work occasional weekdays until 5:00 pm, weekends, and statutory holidays on a rotation basis is required.

WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:

  • Preferred post-secondary education in Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Health Sciences, Nursing, or similar clinical disciplines. Or, experienced Pharmacy Technicians and existing special authorization professionals.
  • Knowledge of pharmacotherapy, disease states, treatment guidelines, drug reimbursement principles, and clinical decision-making.
  • Preferred experience in Special Authorization, drug benefits administration, pharmacy practice, formulary management, drug utilization review, or health insurance adjudication.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
  • High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and commitment to quality work.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel; Access experience is considered an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, supported by strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive and flexible approach.
  • Service-oriented and responsive, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external customers.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE:

  • This role is well suited to pharmacology graduates, experienced pharmacy technicians, and drug benefits professionals who are looking to apply their medication knowledge in a meaningful alternative career path outside of traditional dispensing or frontline pharmacy practice.
  • The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys analyzing clinical information, applying drug coverage criteria, and making thoughtful, evidence-informed decisions that influence whether members can access the medications they need.
  • This opportunity may be especially attractive to experienced clinicians and pharmacy professionals seeking a role that offers clinical complexity, meaningful member impact, and the ability to contribute to medication access without the demands of a retail, hospital, or direct patient-care environment.

This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

Alberta Blue Cross® is an inclusive employer committed to a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We empower and are advocates for our team members by welcoming, respecting and valuing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

At Keen Software House, we develop large-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Artist to join our international team working on Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2.

We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.

You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials - from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.

This is not a purely execution-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.

You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution - someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.

We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs - spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.

While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET +/- 2 hour)

If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!

Required profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.
  • Basic knowledge of or hands-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
  • Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
  • Proven experience creating assets such as:
    • key visuals and campaign artwork
    • promotional and store screenshots
    • banners and social media assets
    • splash screens
    • logos and branding elements
    • promotional compositions based on in-game or 3D content
  • Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
  • Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy

Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms

  • Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
  • Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
  • Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post-processing skills
  • Ability to take existing in-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
  • Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
  • Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
  • Proactive, self-driven mindset and ability to work independently
  • Fluent English, spoken and written
  • Shares and upholds our High Standards

Due to the seniority of this role, we will only consider candidates who meet the requirements above.

Nice to have

  • Experience with motion graphics or video editing
  • Familiarity with Figma
  • UI/UX or in-game UI experience
  • Experience working on sci-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

Key responsibilities

  • Report to the Executive Producer
  • Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
  • Create high-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
  • Develop compelling visual concepts based on in-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
  • Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
    • key visuals
    • promotional screenshots and beauty shots
    • store and platform assets
    • banners
    • social media graphics
    • splash screens
    • logos and branding elements
    • campaign visuals
    • event and presentation materials
    • other 2D promotional artwork
  • Capture, compose and post-process in-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
  • Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
  • Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
  • Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
  • Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
  • Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high-quality final state
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

What we value

  • Hold yourself to A-player standards
  • Strong visual judgment – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
  • Speed, clarity and ownership – we expect results, not status updates
  • Iteration over attachment – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
  • Purpose-driven design – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
  • Versatility – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
  • Direct communication and execution – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

What you’ll find at Keen Software House:

Impact

  • Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
  • Join an international team tackling hard problems

How we work:

  • Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
  • Low bureaucracy, fast decisions

Time off & wellbeing

  • 25 days of annual leave.
  • Flexible sick leave.

Workspace

  • Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague - quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs

Community

  • Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analytics & Data Modelling Specialist to help shape and evolve governed data models and analytical solutions within a complex pharmaceutical and life sciences environment.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between real-world business requirements, complex datasets, data governance, and technical implementation. You will analyse and model real-world data, translate business use cases into governed entity models, and ensure that platform capabilities are developed around genuine business and data needs.

You will work closely with data governance, business, analytics, and engineering teams to establish high-quality, reusable, and well-governed data assets.

  • Analyse complex real-world datasets and design governed entity models based on entities, properties, relationships, cardinality, grain, and underlying data structures.
  • Translate business requirements and real-world use cases into clear data requirements and governed data models.
  • Represent the demand side of the data platform, ensuring that platform capabilities address genuine business needs and analytical use cases.
  • Perform data profiling, data mapping, data quality assessments, and gap analyses to identify data issues, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with data governance teams on data ownership, business definitions, metadata, lineage, quality standards, and governance processes, ensuring models adhere to established standards.

  • Proven expertise in data modelling, data governance, and translating business requirements into governed entity models, including data profiling, mapping, quality assessment, and gap analysis
  • Strong understanding of entity relationships, cardinality, grain, and data structures; ability to convert real datasets into governed entity model instances
  • Experience collaborating with data governance teams on data ownership, definitions, metadata, lineage, quality standards, and governance processes

raw.description:
Customer Solution Architect — Arango AI Product Suite

About Arango:

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens,, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at,LinkedIn, andG2.




About the role

Arango is hiring a Customer Solution Architect to be the primary professional services interface between Arango and the customers deploying our AI product suite. You own the technical relationship end to end, from first discovery through production and expansion. Your job is to turn a customer's problem into a working architecture on Arango's multi-model platform and its GraphRAG and knowledge-graph capabilities, prove value early, and guide the customer's team through deployment and adoption. The role sits where solution architecture, graph data modeling, and applied AI meet. It suits someone who can hold a design conversation with a customer's chief architect in the morning and review a GraphRAG retrieval design with their engineers in the afternoon. Deep graph expertise is not optional here. It is the core of how Arango's AI suite delivers value, and the CSA is expected to be the customer's most trusted source of graph and GraphRAG design judgment.

Location: Anywhere in the United Kingdom/ Remote


Key responsibilities
  • Own the technical customer relationship as the primary professional services contact across the full lifecycle: discovery, design, pilot, production, and expansion.
  • Run discovery with customer sponsors, domain experts, and operators to identify high-value use cases for Arango's AI product suite, and qualify them against real business outcomes.
  • Design target architectures on Arango's multi-model platform, including graph data models, AQL query and traversal patterns, and GraphRAG retrieval design tailored to the customer's domain.
  • Define success criteria, SLAs/SLOs, data access and governance requirements, and a phased delivery plan from proof of value to production.
  • Build reference implementations and prototypes that prove value early: graph schema, data connectors, GraphRAG pipelines, tool and agent orchestration, APIs.
  • Guide production deployment into secure, observable services alongside the customer's engineers, with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and proper testing.
  • Architect retrieval across graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid approaches (chunking, embeddings, ranking, caching), and orchestrate tool and agent calls.
  • Establish evaluation practices and iterate on prompts, models, retrieval strategy, and graph structure using offline and online metrics and A/B tests.
  • Design data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector indices, graph ingestion, and metadata governance.
  • Define monitoring for quality, drift, hallucination and guardrail events, latency, and cost, and stand up alerting and dashboards with the customer.
  • Architect role-based access, secrets management, audit logging, PII redaction, and content safety controls.
  • Meet customer compliance requirements (SOC 2/ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA as applicable).
  • Produce architecture documentation, runbooks, and reusable patterns, and train customer engineers and end users.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Arango's product and engineering teams, shaping the roadmap with what we learn in the field.
Required qualifications
  • Deep graph knowledge (central to this role). Hands-on expertise in graph data modeling, graph query and traversal (AQL, or equivalents such as Cypher or Gremlin), graph algorithms, and knowledge-graph design for AI. Direct experience building GraphRAG or knowledge-graph-backed retrieval for LLM applications.
  • 5+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical professional services, including building and operating production systems.
  • Strong applied AI and Python skills, with a solid grasp of data structures, systems design, concurrency, and networking.
  • Strong database skills across graph, NoSQL, key-value, and document models. Multi-model experience is valued given Arango's platform.
  • Hands-on experience with modern LLMs and tooling (OpenAI/Anthropic/Llama, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, function and tool calling).
  • Retrieval and vector databases (FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), and hybrid retrieval that combines graph and vector.
  • Cloud and containers (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker/Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and CI/CD.
  • Observability (metrics, logs, traces) and performance tuning for latency-sensitive services.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication, with the ability to lead technical conversations from the executive level down to the engineering team.
Nice to have
  • Direct ArangoDB experience, or prior work deploying a graph database in production.
  • Search and IR fundamentals (BM25, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, ColBERT, cross-encoders).
  • Front-end or full-stack experience (TypeScript/React, Next.js) for light UI prototyping.
  • MLOps platforms and evaluation frameworks (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Ragas, promptfoo, DeepEval).
  • Model adaptation and inference optimization awareness (LoRA/PEFT, DPO, distillation, quantization, vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM), enough to advise on tradeoffs rather than to hand-build.
  • Domain experience in finance, healthcare, public sector, manufacturing, or retail.
  • Security and compliance familiarity: data residency, KMS/HSM, private networking.
  • French government or industry experience.
What success looks like (6–12 months)
  • 2 to 4 customer deployments of Arango's AI suite live in production against agreed uptime, latency, and cost targets.
  • Measurable quality and business outcomes (task accuracy, deflection rate, cycle time) backed by evaluation and telemetry.
  • Reusable graph and GraphRAG reference architectures and connectors adopted by the broader delivery team and by customers.
  • Customer teams enabled and self-sufficient, with runbooks, documentation, and training in place, and strong satisfaction and NPS.
  • A credible field feedback loop feeding Arango's product and engineering roadmap.
Our toolset
  • Platform & Graph: ArangoDB multi-model (graph, document, key-value), AQL, graph algorithms, GraphRAG
  • Models & SDKs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Llama, Hugging Face
  • Retrieval: graph traversal plus FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate; rerankers (ColBERT, cross-encoders)
  • Pipelines & Orchestration: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ray, Airflow
  • MLOps & Evals: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Ragas, promptfoo, Great Expectations
  • Serving & Infra: vLLM, TGI, FastAPI/gRPC, Docker/K8s, Terraform, GitHub Actions
  • Observability & Guardrails: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Llama Guard/Content Safety, custom filters
  • Data: Postgres/BigQuery/Snowflake; Kafka; object storage

What Makes Arango Special?

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.
Working at Arango means:
  • Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
  • Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
  • Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications
If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Pakistan

Pakistan is home to the third-largest concentration of technology team members at Moniepoint, and it's one of the fastest-growing markets we hire into, with real headroom for growth in seniority and scope. We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in Pakistan.

About The Role

Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.

The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
  • Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
  • Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
  • Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
  • Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
  • Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.

Who You Are

  • Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
  • Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
  • Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
  • Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
  • A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co-founder
  • A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
  • Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co-founder

Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with

  • Java (latest versions)
  • Spring and Spring Boot
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
  • Work in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high-growth markets.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.

Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data.

Job Type: Freelance
Location: India (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text.
  • Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language).

  • Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.

  • Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.

What we’re looking for:

  • Must be currently living in India.

  • Native-level written and spoken fluency in Gujarati.

  • Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.

  • Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.

  • (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

Automated Test Engineer Job Description ASRC Federal is seeking an Automated Test Engineer to join the Software, Applications and Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE). The successful candidates will become key members of the development team building Cloud-based analytics solutions for our government customer NOAA. This CoE is responsible for designing, developing and delivering backend solutions and services to our customers as well as our internal growth and execution-focused teams. This is a remote, full-time position. This is an opportunity for someone passionate about transforming organizational practices to deliver value to users in an efficient and high-quality fashion. The person(s) selected for this role will become part of an enterprise team of software developers that may split their time working directly on customer systems, solving customer problems. We’re looking for person(s) eager to get in on the ground floor of a growth-focused organization and to work with an established team in a flexible and enjoyable work environment. As a member of the development team, this automated test engineer will be responsible to use automated test tools like WebdriverIO, Axe, Allure and similar E2E frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) tools to create and enhance our automated test suite for both end-to-end system tests, regression tests, acceptance tests, 508 compliance and performance and scalabity tests.

Client Overview:

The successful candidates will initially join an existing project team and develop custom cloud-based backend applications for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), The NOAA Chief Financial Officer (CFO) manages the agency's annual budget (approx. $6.4 billion), overseeing financial planning, accounting,, and performance evaluation. The office ensures fiscal integrity through internal controls, vendor payments, and strategic financial policy to support NOAA's environmental and national security mission. ASRC Federal subsidiaries developed the Financial Management Data System (FMDS) for NOAA to improve the government's ability to analyze and manages its financial and workforce data. FMDS is a Cloud-based visualization and analytics software tool that sits on top of the government's financial system. The system fuses data entered in directly by the NOAA budget community, with data from a variety of disparate back office organizational data sources into one filterable and manageable data set and presents the information through custom visualizations that quickly and effectively allow the user to extrapolate the relevant metrics without assistance from others. The work is in a fast-paced, high visibility, client site environment with regular interaction with all levels of the organization, including NOAA Senior Executives. The team is currently developing backend software solutions leveraging modern technologies and processes including DevSecOps, microservices, RESTful APIs, and AI/ML solutions.

ASRC Federal is seeking:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 8-10 years of experience

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • 3-5+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Java or Python programming languages
  • Technical knowledge and experience with WebDriverIO, Cypressor E2E equivalent QA automation tool(s).
  • Experience in leveraging AI tooling to enhance and maintain automated test scripts
  • Experience in a large-scale software testing and verification environment
  • Experience with 508 compliance automated testing using frameworks like Axe, Cypress or similar with reporting tool like Allure.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to learn quickly and to collaborate with others in a geographically distributed team
  • Experience with Agile workflow methodologies
  • Experience with web-based frameworks such as React
  • Experience with automated test and performance evaluation strategies for microservices
  • Understanding of cloud based technologies and architectures
  • Exposure to working with AWS (ie. codebuild, cloud formation), Node.js, Linux/WSL, CI/CD environments.
  • Highly organized and punctual.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-pace working environment.
  • Ability to understand and prioritize customer needs.
  • Ability to initiate action independently after receiving general guidance/direction.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
  • Must have very strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Must have excellent organizational skills
  • Commitment to NOAA's mission, and prior experience working for NOAA highly desired.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Federal Government Data Science.
  • US Citizen able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance Required

• Preferred skills/experience:

  • Experience working with potential customers and internal teams to assess their business and technical needs.
  • Understanding of the latest development practices such as:

◦ Agile Methodology ◦ Design for Testability ◦ Application Security ◦ Data Security

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
