AVP Product Management - EM05AE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

AVP, Supplemental Health Product Management

Supplemental Health is a key growth area for The Hartford and a central component of the Employee Benefits strategy. The portfolio includes Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity insurance and has grown from approximately $100 million to $330 million over the past five years. With continued investment in the business, this role offers an opportunity to help shape the next phase of growth and deliver differentiated protection solutions for employers and participants.

The AVP, Supplemental Health Product Management sets the strategy, value proposition, product offering, and end-to-end customer experience for The Hartford's Supplemental Health portfolio. The role shapes growth and financial performance in partnership with leaders across actuarial, underwriting, finance, claims, operations, distribution, marketing, and technology. Reporting to the VP, Product Management, Employee Benefits, this leader manages a seasoned team of four product management professionals and provides broad cross-functional leadership across the Supplemental Health business. This role can be based in any one of our office locations or remotely within the U.S.

Responsibilities

Sets Supplemental Health Strategy in Collaboration with the Employee Benefits Senior Leadership Team

  • Owns The Hartford's Supplemental Health product roadmap across Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity, ensuring the portfolio remains relevant and competitive.

  • Develops and executes multi-year strategies to accelerate growth, strengthen differentiation, and drive enrollment.

  • Maintains an external perspective through customer needs, broker feedback, competitor activity, and market trends; brings forward recommendations for innovation and enhancement.

  • Partners with pricing, actuarial, underwriting, and finance leaders to understand product economics and advance profitable growth objectives; the role influences performance but does not directly own the P&L.

Leads Product and Customer Innovation

  • Leads product development, enhancement, and integration initiatives from concept through filing, implementation, and market launch.

  • Partners with claims, technology, and operations teams to improve the customer experience, modernize product capabilities, and advance integrated solutions.

  • Uses market research, customer insights, broker input, and analytics to identify opportunities to innovate, increase enrollment, and improve speed to market.

Provides Enterprise and Market Leadership

  • Serves as the internal and external face of The Hartford's Supplemental Health portfolio, communicating strategy, capabilities, market perspective, investment needs, and performance.

  • Represents the organization with distribution partners, employers, consultants, industry associations, and brokerage firms.

  • Leads the Supplemental Health cross-functional community of practice and influences priorities across claims, operations, underwriting, actuarial, distribution, technology, and other business areas.

Ensures Regulatory and Compliance Excellence

  • Ensures products and supporting operations remain compliant with applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Partners closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and Government Affairs teams.

Leads and Develops High-Performing Teams

  • Leads, coaches, and develops a seasoned team of four product management professionals.

  • Builds an inclusive, high-performance culture by listening to the team and cross-functional partners, creating alignment, and driving clear decisions and execution.

  • Strengthens organizational capability through mentoring, talent development, and meaningful career opportunities.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Employee Benefits or insurance industry experience, including direct leadership experience with Supplemental Health product strategy and products such as Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity.

  • Proven strategic product leadership experience, with demonstrated success building and executing strategies that drive growth, innovation, market relevance, and improved customer outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of Supplemental Health product development and management, including pricing, underwriting, enrollment, service, claims, regulatory filing, and go-to-market considerations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and align cross-functional partners around a shared strategy.

  • Experience bringing new products or meaningful product enhancements from development and filing through implementation and market launch.

  • Financial acumen and the ability to partner effectively with actuarial, finance, pricing, and underwriting leaders.

  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with credibility to represent the business internally and externally.

  • Proven ability to lead and develop experienced product management talent.

  • Experience leading product growth, transformation, integration, or operating model change within a carrier or comparable organization.

  • Deep understanding of voluntary benefits distribution, enrollment ecosystems, broker and customer needs, and the competitive landscape.

  • Experience advancing integrated customer experiences, digital product capabilities, or platform modernization initiatives.

  • Knowledge of state filing requirements and regulatory frameworks impacting Supplemental Health products.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, with potential for slightly higher travel for candidates outside of Home Office or those who are remotely based.

Compensation

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$180,000 - $270,000

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

raw.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the role:

At Afresh, we’re building data products to define the future of retail grocery analytics. The nerve center of those products is our analytics platform, and as a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science and Analytics team, you’ll be the technical leader of that platform.

Our growing suite of data products range from standardized reports to AI-driven insight engines and agentic analytics tools. They let our customers understand what’s happening in their stores and empower them to reduce food waste. All of these products require a reliable platform of well-modeled data, clearly-defined metrics, and extensive metadata and context.

This platform is also used by teams across the company to ensure customer success and improve our core products. The Data Science and Analytics team collaborates closely with every team in the company, helping them build products and make decisions with data. You will regularly interact with data engineers, product engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations specialists.

What You'll Do:

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science team, you will own the development of our analytics platform. You’ll evolve our data models, solidify our pipelines, and establish data governance patterns to serve our internal- and customer-facing analytics needs. Some of your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving, extending, and optimizing our data analytics architecture to provide reliable and accessible data for our suite of data products;
  • Collaborating with stakeholders across the company to understand their data needs, and then build extensible dimensional models, semantic layer metrics, and agentic context and tooling that will allow for consistent and reliable AI-assisted insights;
  • Evolving our existing data quality and data governance processes; and
  • Mentoring and up-skilling other engineers

This is a high-impact role with ownership of highly visible projects and a lot of room to grow in your scope.

Skills and experience:

raw.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales & Marketing Tools, to join us in South Africa.

About The Role

Sales and Marketing Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Reporting to the Director, Omnichannel & Digital Marketing, the Digital Product Manager is a hands-on execution leader responsible for translating brand and omnichannel strategy into tactical digital plans and flawless delivery across HCP and patient channels. This role plans and drives digital and web-oriented projects from ideation through launch, with day-to-day ownership of execution, launch readiness, and deployment coordination. Working closely with leadership, brand teams, developers, agency partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders, the Digital Product Manager ensures alignment on objectives, scope, timeline, cost, and quality. Success in this role requires deep operational expertise across CRM, email, web, field-enabled digital, and paid media executions; fluency in Veeva and Salesforce Marketing Cloud; command of the PRC/MLR review process; and a customer-centric mindset focused on building scalable, reusable solutions in a lean, fast-moving, launch-focused environment.

Principal Responsibilities

Strategy, Planning & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Translate brand and omnichannel strategy into tactical digital plans and drive execution, working closely with leadership, stakeholders, developers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on objectives and deliverables.
  • Plan and oversee digital and web-oriented projects from ideation to completion that are strategically aligned, including securing cross-functional alignment on project scope, benefits, cost, and timeline.
  • Manage internal and external timelines across projects, with a clear understanding of timeline impacts and dependencies across tactical development and deployment.
  • Maintain integrated digital timelines, trackers, asset inventories, and handoffs across brand, agencies, IT, Analytics, and deployment partners.
  • Translate brand and business objectives into actionable digital execution plans, prioritizing work to deliver the greatest value against launch goals.

HCP & Patient Digital Execution

  • Lead day-to-day HCP and patient digital tactic execution across web, CRM/email, field-enabled digital, and paid media channels; a broad understanding of the HCP landscape is preferred.
  • Own digital launch execution across web and paid media, including content updates, asset handoffs, trafficking, tagging, QA, tracking validation, and go-live readiness.

CRM, Email & Field Enablement

  • Drive CRM/email asset pull-through, applying best practices across triggers, customer journeys, and dynamic modules.
  • Coordinate end-to-end rep-triggered email execution, including content handoff, Veeva configuration, field deployment, testing/QA, versioning, and coordination with field, brand, and agency teams.
  • Build, configure, and deploy content within Veeva and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, ensuring assets are set up and delivered to best-practice standards.

Content Operations, PRC & Compliance

  • Apply a strong understanding of the PRC process, including routing in Veeva PromoMats, managing version control across assets, and collaborating with the PRC team.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of digital platforms and best practices, ensuring execution adheres to regulatory, privacy, and internal governance requirements.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Coordinate dashboard inputs and reporting follow-ups, monitor tactic-level performance and delivery, and surface executional issues and optimization opportunities to brand and Analytics partners.
  • Partner with Analytics and Research teams to connect execution to outcomes, ensure approved measurement plans and tracking requirements are implemented, and inform ongoing optimization.

Partnership & Collaboration

  • Manage agency partners with clear direction, feedback, quality oversight, and accountability for timelines and deliverables.
  • Collaborate closely with internal partners, including HCP and Patient brand teams, IT, Patient Support Services, Analytics, and Research teams, to align objectives and deliverables.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5-7+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, digital product/project management, or omnichannel execution, with pharmaceutical/biotech industry and launch experience strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva (CRM and PromoMats) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including CRM/email and rep-triggered email configuration and deployment.
  • Strong working knowledge of HCP and patient marketing in a regulated industry, including PRC review, Veeva PromoMats routing, version control, FDA promotional requirements, and privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with website content management, media trafficking/tagging, QA, launch readiness, and agency/cross-functional execution.

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong marketing proficiency, project management, verbal, written and executive communication skills are required along with demonstrated presentation skills.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and timelines without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving, launch-focused environment; self-directed, proactive, and accountable for outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret digital performance data, customer insights, and competitive intelligence and translate findings into actionable executional recommendations.

US Salary Range: $130,000-$145,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Director of Customer Success who will lead a Customer Success team that works directly with our Case Management customers across the full customer lifecycle.This role will report to the SVP of Customer Success and be their trusted lieutenantfor proactively orchestrating customers’ activation, onboarding, adoption, engagement, value achievement, retention, and expansion.

This is an important and exciting role that offers the opportunity to make a significant impact to the thousands of Mission-driven organizations delivering direct services to vulnerable populations.Case Management’s Customer Success department owns the long-term relationship with our customers, and this role directly influences their experience and value realization. The successful candidate will be required to contribute to and deliver ondepartmental strategies to achieve company objectives and metrics, all while working closely cross-functionally to ensure a positive overall customer experience. The ideal candidate brings strong people management, a data-driven operating mindset, deep familiarity with the full Customer Success lever set, and the ability to build programs that scale without sacrificing customer outcomes.

Responsibilities:

ImproveYour Teams’ Delivery of the Customer Journey

  • Deeply understand Case Management products and how our products and services can be used by customers to achieve their goals / desired outcomes and realize value

  • Define,implement, and maintaincustomer journey playbooks for your teams to consistently and proactively orchestrate our customers’ journey toward achieving their desired outcomes with our products and services

  • Incorporate self-service and technology-assisted touchpoints that keep customers engaged and progressing toward value at every stage

  • Demonstrate fluency across the full Customer Success lever set - high-touch, pooled, low-touch, and tech-assisted - and know how to sequence and combine them effectively for a mid-market customer base

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve CS operations - including predictive risk scoring, automated escalation triggers, and intelligent segmentation - and champion practical AI adoption within your team

  • Build a culture of data-driven decision-making, using health scores, product usage signals, and engagement data to forecast risk, identify expansion opportunities, and measure program effectiveness

Focus onCustomerValue

  • Develop your team's organizational change management expertise so they can guide customers through adopting Case Management products and help those customers manage change within their own organizations

raw.excerpt: Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic.
raw.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

As our Lead QA Engineer (SDET / QA Automation), you'll build comprehensive, scalable technology and software designed to manage and grow fitness businesses of all sizes. We are looking for a visionary quality engineering technical leader to design and implement advanced test automation frameworks, embed artificial intelligence throughout the QA lifecycle, drive UI visual regression testing capabilities, champion DORA metrics adoption, and elevate overall release confidence — all while growing and mentoring the QA practice through standards, tooling, and cross-functional partnership.

You will lead through test strategy, automation architecture, AI-augmented quality practices, quality standards, mentoring, and cross-functional partnership — not through people management.

If that vision excites you, this is where it gets built. You will spend your days on the test automation and quality systems that protect fitness experiences for millions, in an environment where AI agents are part of how you think, build, test, and review. Every framework you build, every AI-assisted insight you surface, and every standard you set helps prove that AI-native engineering is not a side project here — it is how we build.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

QA Technical Leadership & Agile Execution

  • Be an active participant and lead day-to-day Scrum activities of the team as needed, including planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Review and evaluate business requirements in the form of user stories; lead work breakdown and estimation of tasks based on requirements; provide alternative solutions and negotiate with Product Management.

  • Own small to mid-sized engineering/QA projects or product areas.

  • Lead technical projects; define and oversee test automation and quality delivery for your squad.

  • Review teammates' work to ensure quality and adherence to system architecture and best practices; identify where new designs will require architectural or testability changes.

  • Troubleshoot and reproduce customer-found issues in a timely manner.

  • May supervise the work of QA vendor resources.

AI-Augmented QA & Generative AI

  • Lead the integration of AI and Generative AI (Gen AI) tooling into the QA process, including AI-assisted test generation, intelligent defect triage, and predictive quality analysis.

  • Apply hands-on experience with Gen AI platforms (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to accelerate test case creation, test data generation, and documentation.

  • Evaluate, adopt, and champion AI-native QA tools and agentic IDE development practices, including agent-based QA tooling and intelligent test maintenance.

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual testing burden and increase test coverage and precision.

  • Stay current on advancements in AI/ML as applied to software quality and advocate for their adoption within the QA practice.

UI Visual Comparison & Regression Testing

  • Architect and implement UI visual regression testing capabilities to detect unintended visual changes across application releases and platform updates.

  • Select, configure, and maintain visual comparison tooling (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright visual comparisons, or similar) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Define baseline management standards, screenshot comparison strategies, and tolerance thresholds for visual diffs across browsers and device viewports.

  • Partner with frontend engineers and designers to ensure visual test coverage aligns with design system standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Drive adoption of visual testing as a first-class quality gate within the software delivery lifecycle.

DORA Metrics & Engineering Excellence

  • Lead the organization's DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Mean Time to Restore) measurement and improvement initiative across engineering teams.

  • Establish baseline DORA metric reporting, define targets, and build dashboards that provide actionable visibility to engineering leadership and squads.

  • Identify quality and process bottlenecks that negatively impact DORA metrics and drive initiatives to address them through automation, improved test coverage, and CI/CD optimization.

  • Champion a continuous improvement culture by connecting QA practices directly to DORA outcomes, including reducing change failure rates through shift-left testing and faster test feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering teams to align QA practices with reliability and deployment velocity goals.

Automation Architecture & Frameworks

  • Develop high-quality code; contribute to development standards by setting new patterns and best practices for test automation.

  • Write architecture and design documentation for test frameworks and quality plans as needed.

  • Design reusable test components utilizing standard frameworks; experiment with new technologies that can enhance our QA tech stack.

  • Support and contribute to build, deployment, and monitoring processes with an emphasis on security, performance, and scalability.

  • May participate in build vs. buy analysis and complex decision making for test tooling.

  • Conduct regular, self-guided study to stay current on new and existing technologies; evaluate emerging technologies and practices for suitability at ABC Fitness

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software QA Engineering, or related field (or equivalent industry experience).

  • 6+ years of software development or SDET experience with a strong automation focus.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for test automation, tooling, and framework development.

  • Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing, load testing, and related tools.

  • Significant experience in full life cycle system development including design, building, testing, deployment, upgrade, and support.

  • Experience with application lifecycle management tools (e.g., JIRA) and concepts for version control, work item tracking, and continuous integration.

  • Hands-on experience with REST API testing.

  • Strong knowledge of BDD/TDD methodologies.

  • Familiarity with SQL databases and queries for test data validation.

  • Experience with exploratory testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) applied to software engineering or QA workflows.

  • Experience implementing UI visual regression and comparison testing frameworks (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright, or similar) in a CI/CD pipeline.

  • Proven experience leading or contributing to DORA metrics measurement and improvement efforts across engineering teams.

  • Experience in applying different techniques, tools, and approaches based on context.

  • Experience testing technically complex systems including microservice-oriented and distributed systems with fail-safe requirements.

  • Experience with shift-left testing (early in development) and shift-right testing (in production environments) techniques.

  • Strong problem-solving skills; critical thinking and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills for collaborating with developers, product managers, and stakeholders.

  • Knowledgeable about performance tuning, scalability, security, reliability, and other non-functional testing concepts.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience building or evaluating AI-powered test generation and intelligent test maintenance pipelines.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompt engineering as applied to QA automation and test case design.

  • Experience with agentic-IDE development and testing practices.

  • Hands-on experience with security testing and performance testing.

  • Experience establishing or owning an engineering metrics program including DORA and other delivery health indicators.

  • Prior exposure to fitness/wellness products and multi-tenant SaaS products.

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

$95,000 - $100,000 CAD and $110,000 - $115,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
  • Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
  • Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
  • Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
  • Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
  • Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
  • And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.


ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: 

ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.


About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com

raw.title: Technical Onboarding Manager
raw.excerpt: Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data.
raw.description:
Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

Technical Onboarding Managers form an important part of the collaborative team between Redox and our customers by developing shared strategies to help our customers reach their integration goals.

You'll use your healthcare experience, clinical workflow understanding and EHR knowledge to provide recommendations and direction to enable new customers to seamlessly onboard using Redox as their integration partner. You'll also play a vital role in helping our customers expand their own understanding and use of Redox and the healthcare integration standards powered by our engine. Finally, you’ll help customers set up their first integration with customers leading them through their go-live. You'll make a positive impact from day one as part of a collaborative and committed team, and will enjoy opportunities to grow toward your strengths and what interests you most.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Partner with customers from contract assignment through their onboarding experience

  • Manage multiple customers and projects at different stages in their onboarding journey with different levels of urgency

  • Act as a trusted collaborator with the customer to prepare technically and operationally for ideal integration outcomes

  • Guide customers through training and troubleshooting as they develop against our API

  • Partner with customers as they prepare operationally, and create documentation for integrations. Also help them understand how to use the Redox tools optimally

  • Work with our customers and their customers to guide them through integrating with their first site

  • Collaborate internally to manage customer onboarding, success plan, and escalations

  • Maintain internal documentation relating to customers and processes

  • Create onboarding collateral for use through our learning management system

  • Keep up to date with product enhancements and how to teach customers to use them

  • Monitor industry trends and how they impact our customers

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical, client-facing role, preferably within Healthcare IT, EHR implementation, or a related SaaS industry

  • Hands-on experience with key healthcare integration standards and data formats (e.g., HL7v2, FHIR, X12, C-CDA) and familiarity with modern APIs

  • Deep understanding of clinical workflows and direct experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technical solutions

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to deconstruct and troubleshoot complex technical challenges

  • Proven success managing a portfolio of multiple, concurrent software projects from start to finish

  • A self-driven work ethic and a demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and initiative

  • Proficiency with AI tools and demonstrated ability to use AI effectively to enhance productivity and decision-making

Who You'll Be Engaging With:

  • Healthcare IT teams and clinical staff at customer organizations

  • Health systems and provider organizations implementing Redox integrations

  • Cross-functional Redox teams including Product, Support, and Sales

  • External healthcare partners and vendors

Nice to have in your background:

  • Demonstrated experience with expanding customers and building franchises

  • Direct experience with one or more healthcare interface engines (e.g., Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf)

  • Experience acting as a mentor or subject matter expert on a project team, guiding colleagues and influencing cross-functional partners to achieve a common goal

  • Previous experience thriving in the dynamic environment of a high-growth, scaling technology company

About Redox - Take a look here:

What We Do

Healthcare organizations and technology vendors connect to Redox once, then authorize what data they send to and receive from partners through a centralized hub. Redox's cloud-based platform is vendor and standards-agnostic and enables the secure and efficient exchange of healthcare data.
This approach eradicates the need for point-to-point integrations and accelerates the discovery, adoption, and distribution of patient and provider-facing technology solutions. With hundreds of healthcare organizations and technology vendors exchanging data today, Redox represents the largest interoperable network in healthcare. Learn how you can leverage the Redox platform at .

Other Stuff About Us

Redox is an EEO company. We fully support the diversity of our team. As part of our ongoing work to build more diverse teams at Redox, you will be asked to complete a voluntary EEO survey when applying. This survey is anonymous, we cannot link your application record with your survey responses. We request that you complete this voluntary survey as we run monthly reports for each team which provides data for diversity in terms of gender and ethnic background in our Applicants and our Hired Redoxers. We take this data very seriously and appreciate your willingness and time to complete this step in the process.
Successful candidates must be eligible to be employed in the U.S. and must reside & work in the continental U.S.
Thank you for your interest in Redox!

With offices in the USA, Canada, and India, Z1 Tech is a global organization fostering diversity, collaboration, and innovation. Since our humble beginnings with just five team members, we've grown to more than 180 employees worldwide, while maintaining the energy and agility of a startup.

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

What you’ll do

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Executive Engagement Marketing Manager for the Americas to lead the operational execution of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the region. This role will translate program strategy into excellent execution by building the systems, communications, tools, tracking, and cross-functional coordination needed to deliver high-touch experiences for senior external audiences.

You will work closely with Sales to identify and engage executives from targeted accounts, enable sellers with clear outreach materials and follow-up workflows, and ensure each program has the right operational foundation before, during, and after the event. The successful candidate is comfortable independently managing multiple complex workstreams, navigating ambiguity, and proactively improving how programs operate at scale.

Responsibilities

Operations and Program Delivery

    • Independently manage the operational planning and execution of a portfolio of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the Americas, including executive dinners, hosted experiences, and sports hospitality programs
    • Build and maintain detailed program plans, timelines, workback schedules, attendee management processes, event briefs, and cross-functional communication plans
    • Partner with the Global Experiential Lead and internal stakeholders to translate program objectives, target audiences, and event formats into clear execution plans

Sales Enablement and Audience Engagement

    • Partner closely with Sales and account teams to support the identification, prioritization, and outreach of senior executives at targeted accounts
    • Develop and manage seller enablement materials, including invitations, outreach templates, event details, attendee lists, follow-up guidance, and account-specific communications
    • Coordinate the end-to-end attendee journey—from invitation strategy and outreach through registration, confirmations, event-day communications, and post-event follow-up

Marketing Operations and Measurement

    • Own the event marketing bill of materials, including email journeys, registration or landing pages, attendee communications, and supporting campaign assets
    • Partner with Marketing Operations to execute campaigns and workflows that support invitations, registration, attendance, and post-event follow-up
    • Partner with Analytics and Program Management to establish consistent tracking, reporting, and measurement for executive engagement programs, aligned with broader marketing standards

Event Execution and Hospitality

    • Coordinate operational details across internal teams, agencies, venues, and other partners to ensure programs are delivered reliably and meet Stripe's brand and hospitality standards
    • Ensure every event delivers a premium, on-brand Stripe experience appropriate for C-suite and senior executive audiences
    • Support on-site event execution as needed

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Build productive working relationships across Experiential, Sales, Regional Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Analytics, Program Management, and external partners, creating clarity around roles, decisions, dependencies, and next steps
    • Communicate proactively and clearly, particularly when tradeoffs, risks, or changes could affect program delivery or the attendee experience

Continuous Improvement and Shared Learning

    • Identify risks, dependencies, and execution gaps early; recommend practical solutions and escalate when broader program decisions are needed
    • Capture learnings and maintain repeatable playbooks, templates, and operating practices that improve future program delivery
    • Use program data, stakeholder feedback, and operational observations to identify opportunities to improve audience targeting, communications, follow-up, and program execution

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, executive programs, hospitality, or a related B2B marketing role
  • Experience managing complex, detail-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently within a defined area of responsibility, prioritize competing workstreams, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to communicate effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external executive audiences
  • Strong project management skills, including experience developing workback plans, coordinating deliverables, tracking progress, and resolving execution issues
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, with experience using program data, stakeholder feedback, and reporting to improve execution
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting executive engagement programs, C-suite events, customer hospitality, hosted dinners, or premium event experiences
  • Experience working in B2B technology, fintech, enterprise marketing, or a similarly complex go-to-market environment
  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, event management, and project management tools, such as Salesforce, Splash, Cvent, Asana, or similar platforms
  • Experience building scalable marketing processes, playbooks, templates, or reporting frameworks
  • Experience with event attribution, pipeline workflows, account-based marketing, or executive audience engagement strategies

raw.description:
Who we are

Memtime is one of the most successful early-stage startups in B2B SaaS, with thousands of customers in over 86 countries. We just got our Series A funding and are now scaling the company. Our mission is to become the new standard for tracking time - integrated with every project software worldwide.

How we work

We are an international team with a hybrid remote work culture and a headquarters office in Munich. At Memtime, we deal with time, which means we respect yours: Instead of endless meetings and compulsory attendance, we believe in well-designed collaboration that gives us a sense of self-efficacy and allows us to see the impact of our daily work through results.

Our Product

With our software for automatic activity tracking, we are the technology leader in our segment:

  • Our software automatically records what your are working on (e.g. emails, documents, websites etc.) - so you can easily remember on which customers/projects you spent your time
  • What makes our software especially employee-friendly: it stores all data exclusively on the user's device. No monitoring or surveillance features. Full privacy for the user.
  • We seamlessly integrate with any kind of project software, erp system or billing solution

About the Team

  • Our Quality Assurance Team is growing, and we are looking for a capable, detail-oriented QA Engineer to ensure our product and integrations meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.
  • As part of the Quality Assurance Team, you will be directly involved in testing our core product —the Memtime App— as well as our cloud services, integrations, website, and internal tools.
  • We are also expanding our product portfolio to smaller companies and freelancers with a new cloud-based product, where high-quality testing and automation will play a vital role.

What we are looking for in you

  • ﻿Experienced QA Engineer with a strong background in software testing and automation for SaaS products.

  • Several years of professional experience in QA roles.

  • Proficient in testing methodologies, including manual testing, ﻿automated testing, and integration testing.
  • Strong focus on customer needs and ensuring a seamless user experience.

  • Skilled at identifying and documenting bugs, edge cases, and improvement opportunities.

Technical Skills

  • Familiar with testing frameworks.

  • Knowledge of SQL databases (SQLite).

  • Familiar with Jira or similar ticketing systems.

  • Proficient in test case design, bug reporting.

  • Fluent in English.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Electron-based applications.

  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools (e.g., Playwright, TestCafe).

  • Experience with test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, etc.).

You Will Be

  • Testing the functionality of our core product and integrations.

  • Writing, maintaining, and improving test automation scripts.

  • Ensuring that all new features and bug fixes are properly tested before deployment.

  • Identifying and reporting bugs and collaborating with developers to resolve them.

  • Verifying the integration of external systems with our product.

  • Helping to define the architecture and workflow for automated testing.

Job Details

  • Fully remote

  • Full-time (40h/week)

  • Hardware will be provided to you (Mac and Windows)

Interview process

Please upload your CV (PDF file) in the application form (Cover letter optional).

If your submission meets our expectations, we invite you to a first meeting to get to know each other (Company, position etc.)

Next step is a Questionnaire to fill out.

If that was successful, we will invite you to a single 1.5-hour interview split into 2 parts:

  1. Technical interview

  2. Your questions

If you pass the interview, we will make you an offer afterwards.

Why you should apply

Memtime is in an exciting stage of growth.

We are still a relatively small team, so your work will have a big impact from day one.

About Us

Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. Our Team

Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.

As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.

The Role

We’re looking for an accomplished, well-rounded Senior Product Manager to join the Quanata Product Team. You’ll bring experience building insurance platforms and a strong understanding of the policy lifecycle, integrations, data modeling, pricing, and underwriting.

In this role, you’ll lead empowered, cross-functional teams in solving meaningful customer and business problems. Your focus will be on shaping product vision and strategy while translating that direction into measurable business outcomes.

You’ll work at the intersection of product, technology, data, and insurance—navigating complex problems, making evidence-based decisions, and helping teams deliver scalable, high-quality products and services.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Data Science, and domain teams to solve complex product and technical challenges.

  • Own Agile product delivery, including goals, priorities, trade-offs, scope, and backlog management across Scrum and Kanban environments.

  • Evaluate build-versus-buy options and recommend approaches that balance product needs, delivery timelines, and cost.

  • Guide technical design discussions, identify dependencies, and consider performance, scalability, security, and architectural quality.

  • Experience leveraging AI to create repeatable workflows that synthesize research, strategy, and execution into actionable outputs that support decision-making and accelerate product delivery.

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable operating effectively in a distributed work environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with a broad range of personal and commercial lines insurance products and configurations.

  • Experience with data science modeling and machine learning practices.

Salary: $210,000 to $280,000

*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.

New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.

All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. raw.description:
About ARKANCE US Company:

At ARKANCE US, we empower design, engineering, construction, and manufacturing teams to work smarter, deliver stronger outcomes, and build a better world. As part of the global ARKANCE Group - a trusted partner with deep industry expertise, innovative technology solutions, and high-performing teams across 19 countries - we bring together technology, consulting, and services that help organizations transform how they design, build, and operate.

Our culture is built on our people and our values - guided by integrity, innovation, customer success, education, financial responsibility, and an employee-first mindset. We believe that when great people come together around a shared purpose and set of values, we create lasting value for our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description Summary

Position Overview:
The Business Analyst, Advisory Services is the entry point into ARKANCE's advisory practice and the analytical engine beneath its engagements. This role does the hands-on work that advisory engagements are built on: gathering and organizing information, scoring maturity assessments, capturing current-state detail, supporting the business case, and producing the clean, well-structured deliverables clients expect.
Working under the direction of consultants and the Senior Consultant, the Business Analyst spends the majority of their time on client project work. They sit in discovery interviews and capture what is said, turn raw inputs into structured findings, build the analysis behind the recommendations, and keep the engagement's evidence organized and traceable. It is a role designed to build advisory capability from the ground up, with a clear path to grow into a consultant as skills and client exposure develop.
The Business Analyst also supports the practice itself, contributing to the reusable templates, benchmarks, and assets that make each engagement faster and more consistent than the last.

Job Description

Essential Functions

Engagement Support & Analysis

  • Gather, organize, and structure information from client interviews, documents, and systems into clear, usable findings.
  • Support maturity assessments by scoring against the rubric, capturing evidence, and flagging where inputs conflict or are thin.
  • Build the analysis behind the recommendations, including gap analysis, opportunity sizing support, and benchmarking inputs.
  • Capture discovery interviews accurately, working against the deliverable tracks so one conversation feeds everything it should.
  • Support the business case with data gathering, modeling support, and the client's own numbers wherever available.

DeliverableProduction

  • Produce clean, well-structured, board-ready deliverables under the direction of consultants and the Senior Consultant.
  • Maintain the quality and consistency of engagement documentation, ensuring findings are evidenced and traceable.
  • Keep the engagement's evidence base organized so any deliverable track can be assembled without rework.
  • Help ensure deliverables meet the practice's standard and definition of done before review.

Practice Contribution & Growth

  • Contribute to reusable templates, benchmarks, and assets that make future engagements faster and more consistent.
  • Build advisory capability through exposure to live engagements, developing toward a consultant role over time.
  • Stay curious about the AECO industry, the client's world, and the digital transformation landscape.
  • Take on increasing ownership of workstreams as skills and client exposure develop.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.
  • Duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs.

Decision-Making & Autonomy

It's a culture we're proud of, and one that has earned us recognition as a Washington Business Journal Best Place to Work for seven consecutive years.

Significance Inc. is seeking an Oracle EBS - System/Solution Architect to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This role will be remote.
This role will be supporting The Department of Labor (DOL) requires Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services for its centralized financial management system, New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS). In addition to core O&M functions, the team will support the continuous improvement of financial management services, ensuring system performance, security, and availability meet the evolving needs of DOL stakeholders. All services will be performed in compliance with the applicable standards, policies, and performance expectations.
As a mission-critical enterprise system, NCFMS underpins DOL’s finance and accounting operations, including invoicing and payments, budget execution, fixed asset management, general ledger oversight, and project accounting. NCFMS was upgraded from Oracle EBS v12.1.3 to Oracle EBS v12.2.9 in February 2022. Subsequent notable upgrades include Replacing DUNS with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI); Single Sign On Implementation (PIV card integration with Azure); Implementation of REST APIs for custom developed screens; Deployment of Oracle Analytics Server for all NCFMS reporting needs; Upgrade to Tungsten Markview 2025.3 (10.6),Capture 11.2; Webservice updates to ETA OJC UMS; Integration with GrantSolutions managed by HHS; Implementation of NCFMS Data-in-Transit and Data-at-Rest Encryption; Integration of NCFMS and Treasury G-Invoicing, including migration to U.S. Treasury’s G-Invoicing system for Interagency Agreements (IAA) (7600A) and Orders (7600B); Modernization of the custom developed User Interface framework from legacy Enterprise Java Beans/OC4J code to ReactJS framework.

Required Skills:

    System Solution Architect designs, maintains, and modernizes enterprise financial systems for the Department of Labor's (DOL) New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS).
    Key Responsibilities
    • System Design: Create scalable architecture blueprints for NCFMS modules, ensuring alignment with federal financial standards.
    • Integration & Modernization: Oversee the integration of financial databases, cloud services, and web applications.
    • Compliance & Security: Enforce federal security controls like NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP compliance requirements.
    • Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with agency program managers, financial analysts, and cybersecurity teams to resolve system bottlenecks.

    Core Requirements

    • Experience: 12+ years in enterprise-scale solution architecture, specifically with federal financial or large-scale Oracle ERP systems.
    • Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, preferably majoring in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.
    • Technical Stack: Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), database administration (Oracle/SQL), and modern API microservices.

Desired Skills:

    DOL is committed to achieving a cutting-edge, adaptable, and sustainable financial management system that meets the evolving needs of the department and its stakeholders that conform to all government regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.

    • Experience with DOL NCFMS or large federal Oracle eBS implementation
    • Agile delivery experience
    • AI focused
    • Team and Client-focused
    • Good communications skills

Additional Information:

    Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Level 5 or 6 clearance

    The work to be performed under this contract action is not anticipated at a gov’t owned/controlled site, however all performance must occur within the continental United States. Accessing Department of Labor (DOL) Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) or logging into the DOL network from outside of the United States is strictly prohibited without proper authorization.

    May be requested to attend meetings in-person at DOL HQ in Washington, DC.

raw.description:
Nift is disrupting performance marketing, delivering millions of new customers to brands every month. We’re looking for a hands-on ML Ops Engineer to partner with our data scientists to turn their models into production-ready systems.

In this role, you’ll report to the Data Science Manager and work closely with our Data Scientists and Product developers. You’ll architect storage and compute, harden training/inference pipelines, and make our ML code, data workflows, and services reliable, reproducible, observable, and cost-efficient. You’ll also set best practices and help scale our platform as Nift grows.

Our Mission:

Nift’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.

Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.

What you will do:

  • ML platform: Productionize training and inference (batch/real-time), establish CI/CD for models, data/versioning practices, and model governance
  • Feature & model lifecycle: Centralize feature generation (e.g., feature store patterns), manage model registry/metadata, and streamline deployment workflows
  • Observability & quality: Implement monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance/latency, and pipeline health with clear alerting and dashboards
  • Engineering excellence: Refactor research code into reusable components, enforce repo structure, testing, logging, and reproducibility
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with DS/Analytics/Engineers to turn prototypes into production systems, provide mentorship and technical guidance
  • Roadmap & standards: Drive the technical vision for ML platform capabilities and establish architectural patterns that become team standards

What you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years in ML Ops, including ownership of ML infrastructure for large-scale systems
  • Software engineering strength: Strong coding, debugging, performance analysis, testing, and CI/CD discipline; reproducible builds. Extensive commercial experience with Python developing automated pipelines bringing ML models to production
  • Cloud & containers: Production experience on AWS, DataBricks, Docker + Kubernetes (EKS/ECS or equivalent)
  • IaC: Terraform or CloudFormation for managed, reviewable environments
  • ML tooling: MLflow/SageMaker (or similar) with a track record of production ML pipelines
  • Monitoring/observability: ML monitoring (quality, drift, performance) and pipeline alerting
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication, comfortable working with data scientists, analysts, and engineers in a fast-paced startup
  • PySpark/Glue/Dask/Kafka: Experience with large-scale batch/stream processing
  • Analytics platforms: Experience integrating 3rd party data
  • Model serving patterns: Familiarity with real-time endpoints, batch scoring, and feature stores
  • Governance & security: Exposure to model governance/compliance and secure ML operations
  • Be mission-oriented: Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of initiative; takes ownership, goes beyond expectations, and does what's needed to get the job done

What you get:

  • Competitive compensation, flexible remote work
  • Unlimited Responsible PTO
  • Great opportunity to join a growing, cash-flow-positive company while having a direct impact on Nift's revenue, growth, scale, and future success

raw.description:
Paid Search Media Analyst (REMOTE) – C-4 Analytics

C-4 Analytics is a fast-growing, private, full-service digital marketing company that excels at helping automotive dealerships increase sales, increase market share, and lower cost per acquisition. C-4 Analytics is committed to developing innovative solutions for every dealer in every market, and to providing the highest levels of accountability and customer service. We are currently hiring for a Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE as we look to expand our team and support our growing roster of local and national clients.

If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for accommodation or an alternative application process.

Who We're Looking For: Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE

We’re looking for a data-driven, high-impact Paid Search Media Analyst to take full ownership of campaign success across our client portfolio. This isn’t a hands-off strategy role; it’s a hands-on, conversion-focused, revenue-driving position where you will build, optimize, and scale high-performing paid media campaigns. You’ll be responsible for the full lifecycle of paid search (PPC) execution, from conducting deep keyword research and crafting compelling ad copy to optimizing conversion paths on client websites.

You’ll blend analytical rigor with creative execution, developing visually captivating ads and high-converting copy across search engines, display networks, and paid social platforms like Facebook and Instagram. Reporting to digital marketing leadership, you’ll navigate complex paid media landscapes to consistently hit client KPIs, translate performance metrics into strategic growth, and refine campaign mechanics. If you are a relentless marketer who thrives on connecting search intent to measurable business results, you’ll do well here.

A day in the life of a Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE

  • Campaign Strategy & Execution: Build, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across search, display, and social platforms, adjusting campaign pacing and budget allocation to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Performance Analysis & Optimization: Continuously monitor campaign performance, conduct competitive benchmarking, and analyze data to uncover insights, identify trends, and refine targeting strategies.
  • Client Engagement & Strategic Leadership: Act as the subject matter expert by leading client presentations, reporting on key metrics, proposing new growth opportunities, and aligning strategies with overall business goals.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with creative and analytics teams to integrate digital marketing efforts, build compelling ad assets, and streamline campaign execution.
  • Industry Leadership & Partner Relations: Stay ahead of paid search advancements, build relationships with major ad platform partners, and participate in internal knowledge sharing to introduce cutting-edge tactics.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Education & Professional Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) paired with 2+ years in digital media planning, automotive marketing, account management, or client services.
  • Certifications, Platforms & Data Expertise: Active certifications in Google Analytics and Google Ads (including Advanced Display and Video), with hands-on proficiency in major ad-serving platforms (Google, Bing, Facebook, The Trade Desk) and third-party data providers like Oracle.
  • Campaign & Program Management: Proven capability to plan, implement, manage, measure, and report on programmatic digital media campaigns across diverse channels, with a willingness to continually adapt and learn new channels.
  • Analytical & Technical Proficiency: Strong capability to research industry statistics, analyze performance data, execute detailed record-keeping, and leverage Google Workspace and internal management systems to evaluate and design programs.
  • Communication, Copywriting & Collaboration: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to write creative marketing copy across multiple formats, draft professional correspondence, collaborate cross-functionally, and handle sensitive information discretely.
  • Organization & Proactive Execution: Self-starter with organizational agility, strong time management, and a proactive mindset to delegate tasks, navigate shifting priorities, and flag workflow issues early in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation:

We offer a competitive compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications. The salary range for this position is $60,000.00 - $75,000.00. The final salary will be determined based on factors such as skills, knowledge, and demonstrated expertise.

Please note that the stated salary range is flexible and negotiable based on individual qualifications and fit for the role. We encourage candidates to discuss their salary expectations during the interview process.

Flexibility:

The Paid Search Media Analyst may benefit from the flexibility to work in a way that suits them best. We offer the following working options:

  • Office-Based: Our modern and well-equipped office space provides a collaborative environment where you can work closely with your team, engage in face-to-face interactions, and foster a sense of community.
  • Remote: We understand that some individuals thrive in a remote working setup. As such, we support remote work arrangements, allowing you to work from the comfort of your own home or any location that enhances your productivity.
  • Hybrid: For those who prefer a balance between office and remote work, we offer a hybrid model. This allows you to divide your time between working in the office and remotely, providing the best of both worlds.

Working at C-4 Analytics

We provide our employees with a range of benefits, including career development programs, unlimited paid time off, and additional perks. All are welcome to visit our careers and culture page for more details.

More About C-4 Analytics

C-4 Analytics takes the guesswork out of advertising. We don’t over-promise: we over-deliver. We provide real value to our clients because we really value them as partners. We love Google and Facebook, but also love Instagram and Bing. We innovate, educate and instigate. We are forward-thinking, but we learn from the past. We are results-driven and our strategies drive results. We love the practical applications of psychology to marketing, but we aren’t above a good practical joke. We are team players, but we love to crush our competitors. We create an environment of respect and we respect the environment. We are the brains and the good looks. We are very humble. We are nerds, but cool, likable nerds. We are never gonna give you up. Never gonna let you down. We are all work and all play. We calculated that only 15.8% of visitors who started this paragraph would actually read this far down. We are C-4 Analytics.

Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösung ginisuite suchen wir freiberufliche Unterstützung für ein zeitlich befristetes Produktprojekt. Der Projektstart ist zum 01.10.2026 vorgesehen. Die geplante Projektlaufzeit beträgt zunächst drei bis sechs Monate.

  • Dokumentation der erarbeiteten Konzepte, Entscheidungen und Projektergebnisse

  • Strukturierte Übergabe der vereinbarten Ergebnisse an die zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen bei Arsipa

Projektbezogene Abstimmung

  • Selbstständige Planung und Umsetzung der eigenen Projektaktivitäten innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums

  • Einbringung eigener methodischer Ansätze und fachlicher Empfehlungen

Dein Profil:

  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung in den Bereichen Rechnungswesen, ERP, Abrechnung oder vergleichbaren B2B-Softwarelösungen

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Fachprozesse und deren Übersetzung in konkrete Produktanforderungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit User Stories, Tickets, Akzeptanzkriterien und fachlichen Produktkonzepten

  • Technisches Verständnis in den Bereichen Datenmigration, Datenanalyse und Softwareentwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

Hilfreich für das Projekt sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrung in SaaS-, Plattform- oder ERP-nahen Projekten

  • Kenntnisse cloudbasierter Plattformen, APIs, Integrationen oder verteilter Systeme

  • Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Microservices oder containerbasierte Systemlandschaften
