Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

The Specialist - Employee Experience plays a key role in fostering a positive and productive work environment by supporting the development and execution of employee engagement initiatives. This role combines administrative tasks with creative thinking to keep employees happy and motivated.

Job title:

Specialist - Employee Experience

Job Description:

As a member of the Human Resources team, the Specialist - Employee Experience acts as an information and engagement source supporting the new hire process while promoting the Sagility vision, mission and values.

Key areas of responsibility:

  • Assist with onboarding new hires and ensuring they feel welcome and integrated into the company culture.
  • Entrench in early employee life cycle on a regular basis to impact the employee experience, promote the Sagility culture, and to gauge issues leading to attrition.
  • Serve as a point of contact to the employee to find and resolve any needs that may come up prior to joining.
  • Conduct Focus Groups to gather feedback from employees to understand their needs and interests and use this information to shape future engagement efforts including reporting to departmental leaders.
  • Maintain up to date class lists and data trackers on a daily basis.
  • Meet Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Actively inspect employee photo ID validation throughout the tech check and onboarding processes to ensure compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate with the appropriate department to alert them if there are at-risk classes proactively.
  • Coordinate engagement of functional teams during training.
  • Model Rewards and Recognition for achievements, exceptional work etc.
  • Coordinate and ensure personal contact via phone, email or text for any no call no show employees during the onboarding process.
  • Conduct and update the welcoming and new hire orientation program to ensure positive feedback.
  • Manage and deliver New Hire Orientation and presentation materials.
  • Educate all new hire on the VoE program and communications.
  • Act as a cultural role model and drive accountability for exhibiting behaviours aligned to our core values.
  • The above statements are intended to indicate the general nature and level of work being performed by employees within this classification. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this job. Employees in this job may perform other duties as assigned. In addition to the above, all Sagility employees are expected to:
  • Promote teamwork and cooperative effort.
  • Help train and give guidance to other Sagility employees.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and unobstructed work area, and practice good safety habits.
  • Provide internal and external customers with the highest quality service.

raw.title: Territory Manager, Luxury Hospitality & Wellness Sales — Pilates Commercial
raw.excerpt: iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience.
raw.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We are currently seeking an ambitious pace-setter to join our team as Territory Manager, Luxury Hospitality & Wellness Sales — Pilates Commercial, remotely in the United States. This is a hunter role for someone who knows the luxury hospitality and wellness landscape in the East, can build relationships at the right levels, and has the drive to close meaningful accounts and build a book of business from the ground up.

ROLE COMMITMENTS

  • Own and grow a defined territory across the United States within the luxury hospitality and wellness segment.
  • Establish iFIT Pilates as the preferred reformer solution for premium fitness and wellness amenities at four- and five-star properties, destination spas, and luxury resort brands in the region.
  • Develop and manage a healthy pipeline of hotel, resort, spa, and wellness accounts with a consistent bias toward closing.
  • Build lasting relationships with procurement, spa, and fitness decision-makers at key accounts — driving both new business and account retention.
  • Represent iFIT's brand standard at every touchpoint — delivering a client experience that matches the premium nature of our product.
  • Drive subscription-based sales models alongside hardware, ensuring successful adoption and growth across the eastern customer base.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify and prioritize a target account list of luxury hotel groups, independent five-star properties, destination resorts, and spa management companies across the eastern US.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and site visits through proposal, negotiation, and installation coordination — with a strong bias for closing.
  • Develop and execute vertical-specific sales strategies for boutique Pilates studios, premium hospitality, and wellness properties, focused on ROI and how luxury fitness amenities are purchased and operated.
  • Secure premium placements of the full NordicTrack Ultra line — including the Ultra 1 Reformer and Ultra series treadmills — in key accounts across the territory.
  • Create bespoke proposals and commercial packages tailored to hospitality buyers, including equipment configuration, iFIT membership integration, and ongoing service support.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Member Services to ensure white-glove installation, onboarding, and ongoing support standards that match the expectations of luxury hospitality partners.
  • Maintain an accurate and detailed CRM pipeline, providing regular forecasting and account updates to the Global Director.
  • Attend and represent iFIT at key industry events within the eastern region including ISPA, boutique fitness summits, and major Pilates conferences.
  • Partner with Marketing and Product to develop client-specific collateral and demo experiences that resonate with boutique and hospitality buyers.
  • Work alongside the core Pilates team to support Pilates education programs that complement sales goals.
  • Identify adjacent verticals within the wellness real estate space including luxury residential buildings, wellness-focused co-living developments, boutique fitness studios, and private clubs.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education and Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of B2B outside sales experience, ideally in fitness, wellness, or luxury hospitality.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a territory independently and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Genuine knowledge of the Pilates discipline including reformer methodology, studio culture, and the competitive equipment landscape.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools; Salesforce preferred.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Ability to travel regularly within the eastern US territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An existing network of relationships with procurement, spa, and fitness decision-makers at major hotel brands operating in the eastern US such as Four Seasons, Aman, Rosewood, Montage, Auberge, and Marriott Luxury Brands.
  • Experience as a Pilates instructor, studio owner, or figure in the Pilates industry — someone who can speak to the category authentically.
  • A personal aesthetic and professional presence that resonates in luxury environments.
  • Experience selling premium equipment or technology into fitness, spa, or hospitality settings with an understanding of capital expenditure cycles and amenity budget structures.
  • Comfort with consultative, relationship-driven selling at the C-suite and VP level.

DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.
Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.
Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.

$60,000—$70,000 USD

raw.description:
The Opportunity:

We are looking for a talented Customer Solutions Manager to play a key role in the Customer Solutions team. You have a strong history with Telecom RF& Machine Learning and ideally, you have some experience with SQL, Python & Tableau when needed. You’ll be instrumental in delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our users and clients. We value curiosity, innovation and willingness to continuously learn new technologies.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the success of a rapidly growing company with a global footprint.

We foster a flexible, inclusive work environment that values creativity, collaboration, and individual expression. If you’re excited about solving complex Wi-Fi networking challenges for customers and driven by customer success, we’d love to meet you.

Expectations For Success

  • Act as the primary, dedicated point of contact for many of Ookla’s highest valued customers

  • Actively develop and grow relationships across your customer’s business and technical organizations

  • Educate, train, and support our clients to ensure optimum utilization of our product suite

  • Act as the primary resolution function for any issues or questions raised by your customers

  • Personally troubleshoot customer-facing business and technical issues, and drive issue escalation within Ookla as needed

  • Engage with Director and C-Level executives in support of their business needs

  • Partner internally with the sales team to periodically review account health and identify opportunities for future growth within your accounts, and assist with pre-sales activities

  • Champion and advocate for customer requirements within Ookla (be their voice)

  • Participate in customer requested meetings (onsite or via phone)

  • Continually develop your own knowledge and application of new technologies to support and enable growth of our customers

  • Think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges as you help our customers take advantage of Ookla’s data products.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency in reporting, analysis, customer communication, and internal workflows.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across customer success, technical analysis, and operational processes.

  • Support the development of AI-assisted dashboards, summaries, insights, and executive-ready outputs.

  • Use AI to accelerate market analysis, customer benchmarking, root-cause investigation, and trend identification.

  • Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to explore AI-driven use cases that improve customer value.

Requirements

We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your life experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

  • 5 ­- 10 years of enterprise-level, technology-related support or account management experience

  • Exceptional customer focus and bias for action

  • Experience supporting nascent products/services into new markets is strongly desired

  • Adept at establishing and developing relationships across customer organizations

  • Strong technical problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly

  • Experience with data analytics, including applications like Tableau, SQL and advanced Excel functions

  • Experience visualizing big data to demonstrate value and quality to customers

  • Experience in Data Modelling and AI & ML desirable.

  • Familiarity with internet, cellular and broadband technology and infrastructure

  • At least some experience with RAN/RF

  • Self-motivated with a track record of appropriate urgency and follow-through

  • Strong verbal and written communications skills with both clients and internal audiences, able to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization

  • Knowledge and expertise with Ookla’s product offerings, including our licensing, data, and awards, or experience with similar technology-based product offerings

  • Ability to travel regularly to meet and connect with existing clients, and to attend Ookla corporate and team functions

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to see/understand the big picture

  • Global business experience a plus, with special focus on supporting the needs of an international customer base

  • Technical Program or Project Management experience a plus

  • B.A./B.S. degree or equivalent, Master’s degree or international business education a plus

About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at.

The salary compensation for this role is x - x. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

raw.excerpt: SLR is a global leader in sustainability solutions, working with clients to help make sustainability happen, within a collaborative, people-first culture.
raw.description:
SLR is a global leader in sustainability solutions, working with clients to help make sustainability happen, within a collaborative, people-first culture.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project or Senior Hydraulic Modeller to join our established Flood Risk and Water Environment team, delivering high-profile projects across the UK for public and private sector clients.

You'll join a friendly, collaborative group of Hydraulic Modellers, Hydrologists, Hydrogeologists, Water Resources Planners and Water Quality Scientists.

We would be keen to hire into an office with an existing modelling/hydrology team presence, including Manchester, London and Edinburgh. However, we would be happy to consider other office locations or remote working for the right candidate.

You'll work across a diverse portfolio of projects for both public and private sector clients, including developers, Local Flood Authorities, water companies and environmental regulators. As a member of the team, you'll combine technical excellence with project delivery, helping to shape and grow our hydraulic modelling capability and be able the shape the work you do.

The role includes:

  • Delivering hydraulic modelling and flood risk projects from inception through to completion.
  • Building, interrogating and self-checking 1D and 2D hydraulic models using industry-standard software including Flood Modeller and TUFLOW.
  • Preparing technical reports, model documentation and supporting calculations to a high technical standard ready for senior review and submission.
  • Producing and contributing to Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for developments and infrastructure projects primarily across England and Scotland.
  • Undertaking site visits and catchment walkovers to inform hydraulic model development, flood risk assessments and project delivery.
  • Liaising with clients, regulators (e.g., EA, SEPA, NRW, OPW), Local Lead Flood Authorities and other key stakeholders throughout project delivery.
  • Working collaboratively with hydrologists, water environment specialists and other technical disciplines to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Supporting project planning, programme management and technical quality assurance processes.
  • Contributing to the continued development and growth of our flood risk and hydraulic modelling capability.

You'll collaborate with colleagues across Environmental and Earth Sciences, Planning, ESIA and Engineering, along with Global Advisory, on complex and impactful projects that improve resilience, manage flood risk and support sustainable development.

Rewards & Benefits

SLR's 'One Team' culture is at the heart of our business, providing a collaborative and supportive environment where people can develop and grow. Through a structured career framework, regular performance reviews, and support towards chartership, professional qualifications and licences, we offer excellent opportunities for long-term career progression.

Our flexible benefits and reward package includes:

  • Competitive salary with discretionary bonus
  • Company pension
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life, income and travel insurance
  • Salary sacrifice car lease and cycle-to-work schemes
  • Flexible, hybrid and agile working
  • 25 days' annual leave plus flexible public holidays
  • Buy or sell leave options
  • Core working hours
  • Cross-border remote working and sabbatical opportunities
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave pay
  • Workplace Nursery benefit
  • Volunteering and Community Giving
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Specialist support for mental health, stress and menopause, supporting our people both professionally and personally

About You

As a Hydraulic Modeller with proven consultancy or similar commercially based experience, we would envisage that:

  • You hold a degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering Sciences, Geography, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
  • You are Chartered or working towards Chartership through ICE, CIWEM or a similar professional institution.
  • You will be able to demonstrate:
    • Strong experience developing, operating and interrogating hydraulic models using Flood Modeller and TUFLOW.
    • Experience delivering hydraulic modelling studies to support flood risk management, planning and infrastructure projects.
    • Experience preparing and self-checking technically robust reports (model build reports, model verification reports) and hydraulic modelling outputs and flood mapping deliverables.
    • Experience preparing Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) in England and Scotland.
    • Good knowledge of relevant flood risk policy, guidance and regulatory requirements, including those of the Environment Agency, SEPA and Local Lead Flood Authorities.
    • Experience undertaking site visits and using site observations to inform hydraulic model development and flood risk assessments.
    • Experience liaising with clients, regulators and stakeholders throughout project delivery.
    • Experience using GIS software such as ArcGIS Pro or QGIS.
    • The ability to work independently with appropriate supervision managing their own time / resource and working to project scope / budgets / programme and to effectively manage competing priorities across multiple projects.
    • Experience working on both public and private sector projects.
    • Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • The ability to contribute positively within multidisciplinary project teams.

Desirable

  • Experience using additional hydraulic modelling software such as InfoWorks ICM and HEC-RAS.
  • Experience deriving hydrological inputs for hydraulic models using methodologies and software including FEH, ReFH2, WINFAP and LowFlows.
  • Coding experience using Python, R or similar package and an interest is building tools to maximise efficiencies.
  • Experience supporting catchment-scale flood risk studies and strategic flood risk assessments.
  • Understanding of river restoration, natural flood management, drainage or wider water environment projects.

Culture & Inclusion

Inclusion is fundamental to who we are. We are committed to equal opportunities and foster a workplace where everyone can thrive, supported by active Culture & Inclusion Committees and Employee Networks. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

If this Project or Senior Hydraulic Modeller role feels like a great fit for your experience and ambitions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Customer Sales Analyst (CSA) embodies this aspiration perfectly and will be a vital role to help support driving growth in the new Alternative Channels sales area. The CSA will help provide data for sales growth planning, drive communication across customer teams, and help coordinate key meetings and information needs across internal stakeholders.

raw.description:
Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar.

Join the VRChat team!

We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves.

We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms.

You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed.

  • Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability.

  • Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable.

  • Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists.

  • Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness.

  • Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar.

  • Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026.

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work).

  • You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well.

  • You can write scripts (most likely C#) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk.

  • You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality.

  • You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them.

  • You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow.

  • You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.”

Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!)

  • Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity.

Where You’ll Be

    This is a remote-first role. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. We’re a fully distributed company with team members across the globe. While we work asynchronously, overlap with U.S. time zones is needed for team collaboration.

Benefits

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement enterprise-grade Azure cloud architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, identity, and data services, with explicit attention to scalability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code through version control and peer review.
  • Configure and manage Azure landing zones, virtual networks, subnets, route tables, and network security groups to enforce strong segmentation and least-privilege connectivity between workloads.
  • Implement secure identity, access management, and governance controls using Azure Active Directory, conditional access, role-based access control, and Azure Policy to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
  • Architect and operate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pool design, auto-scaling, network policy, and integration with container registries and service meshes.
  • Deploy, scale, and tune Azure data and analytics platforms such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, and Event Hubs to meet specific workload patterns and SLAs.
  • Build and operate comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling fast, automated, and auditable releases of both infrastructure and application code.
  • Design and implement robust observability practices using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and third-party tooling, with thoughtful dashboards, alerting, and SLO tracking.
  • Drive Azure cost optimization initiatives, including right-sizing, reserved-instance planning, lifecycle policies, and architectural changes that meaningfully reduce monthly cloud spend.
  • Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity strategies, including backup, geo-replication, failover testing, and documented runbooks that have been validated through regular drills.
  • Strengthen security posture by integrating Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, key vault, and managed identities, and by routinely remediating findings from compliance scans.
  • Collaborate closely with application teams to architect cloud-native solutions, advising on patterns, anti-patterns, and Azure-native services that best fit each problem domain.
  • Develop automation scripts and tooling in PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline repetitive operational work and reduce time-to-resolution for common incidents.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture reviews, and contribute actively to internal communities of practice around Azure and DevOps.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.
  • Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why United Kingdom

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in the UK.

About The Role

POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.

The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
  • Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
  • Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
  • Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
  • Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.

Who You Are

  • 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
  • Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
  • Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
  • Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
  • Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
  • A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
  • A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
  • Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
  • Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
  • Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.

What we can offer you

  • Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

As Sr. Manager, Professional Services Consulting (Dealer Variable & Fixed Operations), you will lead a team of customer-facing consultants focused on measuring, managing, and improving outcomes inside automotive dealerships. Your team will help dealers implement and maximize the value of Solera SaaS products and consulting programs by turning data into a clear operating rhythm — diagnose performance, take action, and solidify improvements month after month.

This role blends people leadership, operational execution, and KPI ownership, with a primary focus on managing consultants responsible for helping dealers drive Variable and Fixed Operationsperformance —including lead-to-appointment effectiveness, appointment-to-sale conversion, pipeline discipline, SaaS product adoption, inventory acquisition workflows, executive visibility into sales performance— including performance management frameworks for General Managers, General Sales Managers, Used Car Managers, New Car Managers, Group Operations Directors, c-suite executives, etc.; accountability systems that improve customer pay and warranty workflows, service lane effectiveness, technician productivity—including performance management frameworks for Service Advisors, BDC, and Parts teams, etc.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Consulting Team

Manage, coach, and develop a team of consultants to consistently deliver high-quality engagements that improve dealership sales performance and outcomes.

Set clear expectations, reinforce “One Team” behaviors, and model the professionalism and ethical conduct required for customer-facing leadership.

Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to build deep product expertise and strong consulting fundamentals across the team.

Measure and Manage Variable and Fixed Ops Outcomes

  • Establish a KPI-based execution cadence with each dealership that ties consulting activity to measurable improvements in variable and fixed operations performance.
  • Drive accountability systems that improve areas such as: lead handling performance, appointment performance, manager enforcement playbooks, etc.Lead the team in strengthening pipeline discipline, coaching opportunities, and cross-department handoffs tied to KPIs that influence sales conversion and profitability.
  • Lead the team in strengthening operational discipline across the service lifecycle—from appointment scheduling and write-up quality to repair order (RO) management, parts availability, and post-service customer follow-up—ensuring consistency and profitability at every stage.

Examples of outcome areas (Variable Ops): sales funnel response quality, lead response speed, appointment set/show rates, close-rate trends, pipeline management, sales/BDC accountability, marketing spend ROI, trade and purchase appraisal close rates, etc.

Examples of outcome areas (Fixed Ops):service appointment utilization, show rates, effective labor rate (ELR), hours per RO, technician efficiency and proficiency, service drive conversion rates, parts gross profit, inventory obsolescence, and customer retention/service revisit rates.

Operational Excellence and Delivery Quality

Own team planning and execution—ensuring the right coverage, prioritization, and consistency across consulting engagements (virtual and onsite as needed).

Build and refine playbooks, templates, and standard methodologies that help consultants deliver repeatable performance improvements while still tailoring to dealership needs.

Monitor and improve delivery quality through structured inspections (e.g., ride-alongs, call reviews, engagement retrospectives) and targeted coaching plans.

Data-Driven Leadership and KPI Ownership

Track and manage team KPIs and dealership performance outcomes; use trends to coach improvements and provide leadership updates.

Ensure consultants translate dealership and platform data into practical actions—such as CRM data integrity and user behavior audits, executive dashboards, custom KPI tracking, and trend analysis frameworks.

Drive consulting programs that influence sales and inventory economics, including inventory aging strategy, appraisal win-rate accountability, and trade acquisition workflows (as applicable to dealership objectives and Solera solutions).

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Stakeholder Influence

Partner closely with Sales, Account Management / Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to align priorities, share learnings from the field, and improve the customer journey.

Lead execution of departmental and company initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and clear communication across stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Expertise: Strong automotive dealership experience highly preferred; ability to “speak the dealership language” and coach others to care about what our dealers care about.
  • Performance Consulting Leadership: Experience leading teams that drive adoption, ROI, and measurable outcomes through structured KPI management and execution cadence.
  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop high-performing teams through clear expectations and consistent accountability.
  • Communication + Presence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident presenting, training, and influencing across frontline to executive stakeholders.
  • Execution + Ownership: Strong personal accountability, operational rigor, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; comfort using data to tell a story and drive action.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 80% to support onsite delivery, key account outcomes, and team development in the field.

Why Join Us?

At Solera, you’ll lead a team that directly impacts dealership success by turning software and data into measurable Variable Ops performance improvements. You’ll help standardize an operating rhythm that converts insight into consistent execution—driving sales outcomes while shaping how Professional Services scales across Vehicle Solutions.

Therefore, this job description is not comprehensive or exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to adjust, add to or eliminate any aspect of the above description, and to require employees to undertake additional or different responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
The Solera group is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

raw.description:
Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.

Our virtual cards protect 250,000+ users across the U.S., processing over $3 billion in transactions with bank-level security and encryption. From merchant-locked cards that can't be used anywhere else if stolen, to spending limits that block unauthorized charges, to one-click pausing that stops subscriptions instantly, Privacy puts financial control back in users' hands.

We're building a future where every online payment is secure by default, free from data breaches, unauthorized charges, and hidden fees. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' "Top 100 Most Customer-Centric Companies" and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, and Wirecutter.

Privacy is the product that started it all. What began as Privacy.com grew into Lithic, now a Series C company backed by world-class investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. Our dedicated team of 35 sits at the heart of Lithic's 170+ person organization, spanning 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

What we do:

  • Generate virtual payment cards backed by debit cards or bank accounts
  • Enable users to set spending limits, pause cards, and close them instantly
  • Protect users from merchant data breaches and unauthorized recurring charges
  • Help users organize their spending with merchant-locked cards

Why it matters:
With data breaches becoming increasingly common and subscription traps everywhere, consumers need better tools to protect their financial information. Privacy.com processes millions of transactions and serves hundreds of thousands of users who trust us to keep their payment information secure.

The technical challenge:
Building a secure, reliable payments product requires solving complex problems at the intersection of fintech infrastructure, security, user experience, and regulatory compliance. You'll work with real-time transaction processing, fraud detection, payment network integrations, and systems that need to be both fast and bulletproof.

The opportunity:
We're experiencing significant growth from strong product-market fit. We are at the transition point which require scaling the stack, team, and processes.

You'll have the chance to work on features that directly impact over 100K users, with a modern tech stack and a team that values ownership, collaboration, and moving fast.

Job Description

Privacy.com is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to scale to meet the needs of our growth. You will split your time between being hands on coding as well as demonstrate technical leadership in evolving the platform for scale.

You'll become an expert in card payments, solve distributed systems problems at scale, make architectural and product decisions, and mentor other engineers. The team is distributed across the US and Europe. The stack is predominantly NodeJS, DocumentDB and hosted in AWS.

Job responsibilities:

  • Ensure high reliability and correctness for Privacy.com card processing
  • Understand the challenges of the current system and propose step function changes to future architecture
  • Drive large multi-month initiatives and roadmap.
  • Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code.
  • Lead efforts to improve system and processes within the team and across engineering
  • Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with engineering, product, and cross-functional leaders.
  • Make tradeoffs between long term investment and delivering on immediate product value
  • Participate in team on-call rotations

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience shipping code in a fast paced production environment
  • Experience building event-based and advanced distributed systems.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for your work
  • Technical lead for a small team
  • Driven large multi-month migration/re-architecturing projects
  • Experience mentoring and coaching other engineers on distributed systems patterns and best practices
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (designers, PMs, operations)
  • Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for learning

The annual US salary range for this role is $200,000 - $220,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

raw.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

As our Lead QA Engineer (SDET / QA Automation), you'll build comprehensive, scalable technology and software designed to manage and grow fitness businesses of all sizes. We are looking for a visionary quality engineering technical leader to design and implement advanced test automation frameworks, embed artificial intelligence throughout the QA lifecycle, drive UI visual regression testing capabilities, champion DORA metrics adoption, and elevate overall release confidence — all while growing and mentoring the QA practice through standards, tooling, and cross-functional partnership.

You will lead through test strategy, automation architecture, AI-augmented quality practices, quality standards, mentoring, and cross-functional partnership — not through people management.

If that vision excites you, this is where it gets built. You will spend your days on the test automation and quality systems that protect fitness experiences for millions, in an environment where AI agents are part of how you think, build, test, and review. Every framework you build, every AI-assisted insight you surface, and every standard you set helps prove that AI-native engineering is not a side project here — it is how we build.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

QA Technical Leadership & Agile Execution

  • Be an active participant and lead day-to-day Scrum activities of the team as needed, including planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Review and evaluate business requirements in the form of user stories; lead work breakdown and estimation of tasks based on requirements; provide alternative solutions and negotiate with Product Management.

  • Own small to mid-sized engineering/QA projects or product areas.

  • Lead technical projects; define and oversee test automation and quality delivery for your squad.

  • Review teammates' work to ensure quality and adherence to system architecture and best practices; identify where new designs will require architectural or testability changes.

  • Troubleshoot and reproduce customer-found issues in a timely manner.

  • May supervise the work of QA vendor resources.

AI-Augmented QA & Generative AI

  • Lead the integration of AI and Generative AI (Gen AI) tooling into the QA process, including AI-assisted test generation, intelligent defect triage, and predictive quality analysis.

  • Apply hands-on experience with Gen AI platforms (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to accelerate test case creation, test data generation, and documentation.

  • Evaluate, adopt, and champion AI-native QA tools and agentic IDE development practices, including agent-based QA tooling and intelligent test maintenance.

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual testing burden and increase test coverage and precision.

  • Stay current on advancements in AI/ML as applied to software quality and advocate for their adoption within the QA practice.

UI Visual Comparison & Regression Testing

  • Architect and implement UI visual regression testing capabilities to detect unintended visual changes across application releases and platform updates.

  • Select, configure, and maintain visual comparison tooling (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright visual comparisons, or similar) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Define baseline management standards, screenshot comparison strategies, and tolerance thresholds for visual diffs across browsers and device viewports.

  • Partner with frontend engineers and designers to ensure visual test coverage aligns with design system standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Drive adoption of visual testing as a first-class quality gate within the software delivery lifecycle.

DORA Metrics & Engineering Excellence

  • Lead the organization's DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Mean Time to Restore) measurement and improvement initiative across engineering teams.

  • Establish baseline DORA metric reporting, define targets, and build dashboards that provide actionable visibility to engineering leadership and squads.

  • Identify quality and process bottlenecks that negatively impact DORA metrics and drive initiatives to address them through automation, improved test coverage, and CI/CD optimization.

  • Champion a continuous improvement culture by connecting QA practices directly to DORA outcomes, including reducing change failure rates through shift-left testing and faster test feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering teams to align QA practices with reliability and deployment velocity goals.

Automation Architecture & Frameworks

  • Develop high-quality code; contribute to development standards by setting new patterns and best practices for test automation.

  • Write architecture and design documentation for test frameworks and quality plans as needed.

  • Design reusable test components utilizing standard frameworks; experiment with new technologies that can enhance our QA tech stack.

  • Support and contribute to build, deployment, and monitoring processes with an emphasis on security, performance, and scalability.

  • May participate in build vs. buy analysis and complex decision making for test tooling.

  • Conduct regular, self-guided study to stay current on new and existing technologies; evaluate emerging technologies and practices for suitability at ABC Fitness

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software QA Engineering, or related field (or equivalent industry experience).

  • 6+ years of software development or SDET experience with a strong automation focus.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for test automation, tooling, and framework development.

  • Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing, load testing, and related tools.

  • Significant experience in full life cycle system development including design, building, testing, deployment, upgrade, and support.

  • Experience with application lifecycle management tools (e.g., JIRA) and concepts for version control, work item tracking, and continuous integration.

  • Hands-on experience with REST API testing.

  • Strong knowledge of BDD/TDD methodologies.

  • Familiarity with SQL databases and queries for test data validation.

  • Experience with exploratory testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) applied to software engineering or QA workflows.

  • Experience implementing UI visual regression and comparison testing frameworks (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright, or similar) in a CI/CD pipeline.

  • Proven experience leading or contributing to DORA metrics measurement and improvement efforts across engineering teams.

  • Experience in applying different techniques, tools, and approaches based on context.

  • Experience testing technically complex systems including microservice-oriented and distributed systems with fail-safe requirements.

  • Experience with shift-left testing (early in development) and shift-right testing (in production environments) techniques.

  • Strong problem-solving skills; critical thinking and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills for collaborating with developers, product managers, and stakeholders.

  • Knowledgeable about performance tuning, scalability, security, reliability, and other non-functional testing concepts.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience building or evaluating AI-powered test generation and intelligent test maintenance pipelines.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompt engineering as applied to QA automation and test case design.

  • Experience with agentic-IDE development and testing practices.

  • Hands-on experience with security testing and performance testing.

  • Experience establishing or owning an engineering metrics program including DORA and other delivery health indicators.

  • Prior exposure to fitness/wellness products and multi-tenant SaaS products.

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

$95,000 - $100,000 CAD and $110,000 - $115,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
  • Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
  • Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
  • Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
  • Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
  • Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
  • And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.


ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: 

ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.


About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

raw.description:
Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

Technical Onboarding Managers form an important part of the collaborative team between Redox and our customers by developing shared strategies to help our customers reach their integration goals.

You'll use your healthcare experience, clinical workflow understanding and EHR knowledge to provide recommendations and direction to enable new customers to seamlessly onboard using Redox as their integration partner. You'll also play a vital role in helping our customers expand their own understanding and use of Redox and the healthcare integration standards powered by our engine. Finally, you’ll help customers set up their first integration with customers leading them through their go-live. You'll make a positive impact from day one as part of a collaborative and committed team, and will enjoy opportunities to grow toward your strengths and what interests you most.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Partner with customers from contract assignment through their onboarding experience

  • Manage multiple customers and projects at different stages in their onboarding journey with different levels of urgency

  • Act as a trusted collaborator with the customer to prepare technically and operationally for ideal integration outcomes

  • Guide customers through training and troubleshooting as they develop against our API

  • Partner with customers as they prepare operationally, and create documentation for integrations. Also help them understand how to use the Redox tools optimally

  • Work with our customers and their customers to guide them through integrating with their first site

  • Collaborate internally to manage customer onboarding, success plan, and escalations

  • Maintain internal documentation relating to customers and processes

  • Create onboarding collateral for use through our learning management system

  • Keep up to date with product enhancements and how to teach customers to use them

  • Monitor industry trends and how they impact our customers

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical, client-facing role, preferably within Healthcare IT, EHR implementation, or a related SaaS industry

  • Hands-on experience with key healthcare integration standards and data formats (e.g., HL7v2, FHIR, X12, C-CDA) and familiarity with modern APIs

  • Deep understanding of clinical workflows and direct experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technical solutions

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to deconstruct and troubleshoot complex technical challenges

  • Proven success managing a portfolio of multiple, concurrent software projects from start to finish

  • A self-driven work ethic and a demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and initiative

  • Proficiency with AI tools and demonstrated ability to use AI effectively to enhance productivity and decision-making

Who You'll Be Engaging With:

  • Healthcare IT teams and clinical staff at customer organizations

  • Health systems and provider organizations implementing Redox integrations

  • Cross-functional Redox teams including Product, Support, and Sales

  • External healthcare partners and vendors

Nice to have in your background:

  • Demonstrated experience with expanding customers and building franchises

  • Direct experience with one or more healthcare interface engines (e.g., Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf)

  • Experience acting as a mentor or subject matter expert on a project team, guiding colleagues and influencing cross-functional partners to achieve a common goal

  • Previous experience thriving in the dynamic environment of a high-growth, scaling technology company

About Redox - Take a look here:

What We Do

Healthcare organizations and technology vendors connect to Redox once, then authorize what data they send to and receive from partners through a centralized hub. Redox's cloud-based platform is vendor and standards-agnostic and enables the secure and efficient exchange of healthcare data.
This approach eradicates the need for point-to-point integrations and accelerates the discovery, adoption, and distribution of patient and provider-facing technology solutions. With hundreds of healthcare organizations and technology vendors exchanging data today, Redox represents the largest interoperable network in healthcare. Learn how you can leverage the Redox platform at .

Other Stuff About Us

Redox is an EEO company. We fully support the diversity of our team. As part of our ongoing work to build more diverse teams at Redox, you will be asked to complete a voluntary EEO survey when applying. This survey is anonymous, we cannot link your application record with your survey responses. We request that you complete this voluntary survey as we run monthly reports for each team which provides data for diversity in terms of gender and ethnic background in our Applicants and our Hired Redoxers. We take this data very seriously and appreciate your willingness and time to complete this step in the process.
Successful candidates must be eligible to be employed in the U.S. and must reside & work in the continental U.S.
Thank you for your interest in Redox!

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

What you’ll do

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Executive Engagement Marketing Manager for the Americas to lead the operational execution of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the region. This role will translate program strategy into excellent execution by building the systems, communications, tools, tracking, and cross-functional coordination needed to deliver high-touch experiences for senior external audiences.

You will work closely with Sales to identify and engage executives from targeted accounts, enable sellers with clear outreach materials and follow-up workflows, and ensure each program has the right operational foundation before, during, and after the event. The successful candidate is comfortable independently managing multiple complex workstreams, navigating ambiguity, and proactively improving how programs operate at scale.

Responsibilities

Operations and Program Delivery

    • Independently manage the operational planning and execution of a portfolio of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the Americas, including executive dinners, hosted experiences, and sports hospitality programs
    • Build and maintain detailed program plans, timelines, workback schedules, attendee management processes, event briefs, and cross-functional communication plans
    • Partner with the Global Experiential Lead and internal stakeholders to translate program objectives, target audiences, and event formats into clear execution plans

Sales Enablement and Audience Engagement

    • Partner closely with Sales and account teams to support the identification, prioritization, and outreach of senior executives at targeted accounts
    • Develop and manage seller enablement materials, including invitations, outreach templates, event details, attendee lists, follow-up guidance, and account-specific communications
    • Coordinate the end-to-end attendee journey—from invitation strategy and outreach through registration, confirmations, event-day communications, and post-event follow-up

Marketing Operations and Measurement

    • Own the event marketing bill of materials, including email journeys, registration or landing pages, attendee communications, and supporting campaign assets
    • Partner with Marketing Operations to execute campaigns and workflows that support invitations, registration, attendance, and post-event follow-up
    • Partner with Analytics and Program Management to establish consistent tracking, reporting, and measurement for executive engagement programs, aligned with broader marketing standards

Event Execution and Hospitality

    • Coordinate operational details across internal teams, agencies, venues, and other partners to ensure programs are delivered reliably and meet Stripe's brand and hospitality standards
    • Ensure every event delivers a premium, on-brand Stripe experience appropriate for C-suite and senior executive audiences
    • Support on-site event execution as needed

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Build productive working relationships across Experiential, Sales, Regional Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Analytics, Program Management, and external partners, creating clarity around roles, decisions, dependencies, and next steps
    • Communicate proactively and clearly, particularly when tradeoffs, risks, or changes could affect program delivery or the attendee experience

Continuous Improvement and Shared Learning

    • Identify risks, dependencies, and execution gaps early; recommend practical solutions and escalate when broader program decisions are needed
    • Capture learnings and maintain repeatable playbooks, templates, and operating practices that improve future program delivery
    • Use program data, stakeholder feedback, and operational observations to identify opportunities to improve audience targeting, communications, follow-up, and program execution

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, executive programs, hospitality, or a related B2B marketing role
  • Experience managing complex, detail-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently within a defined area of responsibility, prioritize competing workstreams, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to communicate effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external executive audiences
  • Strong project management skills, including experience developing workback plans, coordinating deliverables, tracking progress, and resolving execution issues
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, with experience using program data, stakeholder feedback, and reporting to improve execution
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting executive engagement programs, C-suite events, customer hospitality, hosted dinners, or premium event experiences
  • Experience working in B2B technology, fintech, enterprise marketing, or a similarly complex go-to-market environment
  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, event management, and project management tools, such as Salesforce, Splash, Cvent, Asana, or similar platforms
  • Experience building scalable marketing processes, playbooks, templates, or reporting frameworks
  • Experience with event attribution, pipeline workflows, account-based marketing, or executive audience engagement strategies

Our Product

With our software for automatic activity tracking, we are the technology leader in our segment:

  • Our software automatically records what your are working on (e.g. emails, documents, websites etc.) - so you can easily remember on which customers/projects you spent your time
  • What makes our software especially employee-friendly: it stores all data exclusively on the user's device. No monitoring or surveillance features. Full privacy for the user.

  • ﻿Experienced QA Engineer with a strong background in software testing and automation for SaaS products.

  • Several years of professional experience in QA roles.

  • Proficient in testing methodologies, including manual testing, ﻿automated testing, and integration testing.

Memtime is in an exciting stage of growth.

We are still a relatively small team, so your work will have a big impact from day one.
