Role: Public Sector Program Administrator

Location: Remote, US

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Salary: $95,000 - $125,000 per annum, plus benefits including: health, vision/dental insurance; disability, vacation, sickness, 401K

Kinly is a leading integrator of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, and the largest in Europe, serving as a globally trusted technology advisor to leading organisations. For more than 25 years, we have been designing, developing, integrating and supporting complex audiovisual solutions and businesses rely on us to deliver consistently secure and flexible meeting experiences.

The Program Administrator is responsible for planning, managing, and overseeing programs and strategic initiatives that support public sector operations and organizational objectives. This role ensures successful delivery of programs, projects, and services while maintaining compliance with government regulations, policies, and stakeholder expectations. The Program Administrator collaborates with internal departments, external partners, government agencies, and executive leadership to drive operational efficiency, manage budgets, oversee program performance, and support long-term strategic goals. The incumbent serves as the organization's subject matter expert on federal, state, and regulatory compliance requirements affecting public sector business, with particular emphasis on government contracting regulations, sales reporting, fee remittance, and contract price catalog maintenance.

Key Responsibilities:

Compliance Management & Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end compliance across all public sector contracts and programs, establishing policies, procedures, and controls that align with applicable federal and state requirements.

  • Manage and ensure timely, accurate sales reporting in accordance with contractual obligations, including preparation and submission of transactional data reports to government agencies (e.g., Department of the Army, GSA, NASA, various states purchasing authorities)

  • Oversee fee remittance processes (including Industrial Funding Fees and comparable state-level fees), ensuring accurate calculation, timely payment, and complete documentation.

  • Maintain contract price catalog(s) across all public sector vehicles, including GSA Schedule, SEWP, NASPO ValuePoint, and state contracts; coordinate quarterly price updates, additions, and deletions in strict compliance with contract terms. Ensuring that the Kinly catalog is current, accurate and up to date

  • Monitor compliance with Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) where applicable; identify disclosure statement obligations and coordinate with Finance on CAS coverage determinations.

  • Uphold procurement integrity requirements under the Procurement Integrity Act and agency-specific regulations; develop training and internal controls to prevent and detect violations.

  • Ensure adherence to ethics and conduct requirements applicable to government contractors, including OCI (Organizational Conflict of Interest) identification and mitigation.

  • Monitor reporting requirements across all programs and ensure all mandatory disclosures, certifications, sales reports, Fee remittance reports, progress reports, and renewals are submitted accurately and on time.

  • Serve as a liaison between government agencies, community partners, and internal departments to support program delivery.

  • Organize meetings, workshops, and public outreach initiatives to increase program awareness and engagement.

  • Analyze data to identify trends, measure program impact, and recommend improvements.

  • Respond to public inquiries and provide clear, timely information regarding program services and eligibility.

  • Supervise or support administrative staff, interns, or volunteers as needed.

Strategy & Program Development

  • Orchestrate automation of sales tracking and sales fee remittance reports working with the Information management team to leverage existing system capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive public sector compliance strategy aligned with the organization's growth objectives and risk tolerance.

  • Identify opportunities to expand the organization's public sector contract vehicles, evaluate regulatory feasibility, and lead pursuit and implementation efforts.

  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and compliance dashboards; present program health and risk metrics to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Stay current on regulatory changes (FAR/DFARS, UCC, state procurement codes, FCC regulations) and proactively assess impact on existing programs, recommending and implementing necessary changes.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Guidance

  • Act as the primary internal resource for contract compliance inquiries from Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations, Product Marketing teams and other Kinly Business units.

  • Guide sales teams in public sector deal structuring, pricing compliance, and customer-facing representations to ensure conformance with contract terms and applicable law.

  • Collaborate with Contract Management and Legal Counsel as appropriate on contract review, modification, and dispute resolution related to public sector agreements.

  • Lead internal training programs on government contracting compliance, ethics, procurement integrity, and applicable regulatory frameworks.

  • Coordinate with external auditors, contracting officers, and agency representatives during audits, reviews, and contract administration activities.

Regulatory & Legal Compliance

  • Ensure programs comply with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Maintain documentation, Sales and Fee reporting, and audit readiness for program activities.

  • Support policy development and process improvement initiatives.

  • Interpret and apply Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and agency supplements (DFARS, GSAM, etc.) to day-to-day contracting and compliance activities.

  • Apply relevant provisions of regulations to commercial transactions and contract terms under hybrid or commercial item contracts.

  • Monitor applicable state procurement laws and regulations across targeted public sector markets; ensure contract vehicles and sales activities comply with state-specific requirements.

  • Oversee compliance with FCC regulations as they apply to the organization's products, services, and public sector offerings where applicable.

  • Coordinate completion of required certifications, representations, and disclosures (e.g., registration, TAA compliance, small business subcontracting plans).

Skills & Experience:

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive professional experience in one or more of the following disciplines: IT Sales (Inside or Field), Contract Compliance, Business Development, Product Marketing, or Public Sector Programs.

  • At least 3 of the required years of experience must have been gained working directly within or extensively supporting federal or state government contracting environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing GSA Schedule contracts (MAS), IDIQ contracts, State cooperative purchasing agreements, or similar government contract vehicles.

  • Proven track record of managing compliance programs across multiple concurrent government contracts.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong working knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and key agency supplements; ability to research, interpret, and apply regulatory guidance independently.

  • Familiarity with the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) as applied to commercial and government contracts.

  • Working knowledge of applicable state procurement laws and purchasing regulations across multiple jurisdictions. Knowledge of government operations, procurement, and compliance standards

  • Understanding of FCC regulations relevant to telecommunications and IT products/services.

  • Proficiency in Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) applicability determinations and related disclosure requirements.

  • Strong command of procurement integrity requirements, ethics regulations, and government contractor standards of conduct.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance for non-legal audiences.

  • Proficiency with government contracting systems (, GSA eMod/MAS systems, state portal equivalents) and standard business applications (Microsoft Office Suite, ERP/CRM platforms).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GSA, SEWP, NASPO ValuePoint, OMNIA Partners, or other cooperative purchasing vehicles.

  • Familiarity with DFARS and DoD-specific contracting requirements.

  • Prior experience supporting audits by the GSA Inspector General, DCAA, or similar oversight bodies.

  • Background in IT products, solutions, or managed services sold into the public sector.

  • Experience developing and delivering compliance training programs.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance WordPress applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in WordPress development, custom plugin development, API integrations, and third-party system integrations, with a focus on delivering secure, optimized, and business-critical web solutions.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress websites, themes, and plugins following industry best practices.
  • Design and implement custom WordPress plugins and extend existing platform functionalities.
  • Build, integrate, and maintain REST APIs, third-party applications, and external business systems.
  • Develop and manage integrations with payment gateways, CRM platforms, marketing tools, and other enterprise applications.
  • Customize and optimize WordPress themes to ensure responsive, user-friendly, and visually appealing experiences.
  • Optimize website performance, scalability, security, and overall reliability.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX Designers, Product Managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex website, plugin, and integration-related issues.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to architecture, technical design, and development best practices.
  • Ensure adherence to coding standards, version control processes, and deployment procedures.
  • Monitor and improve website performance through caching, database optimization, and performance tuning techniques.
  • Support deployment activities, production releases, and post-production maintenance.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in WordPress development.
  • Strong expertise in PHP, WordPress, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery.
  • Hands-on experience with REST API development and integration.
  • Proven experience with third-party integrations, including payment gateways, CRM platforms, marketing tools, and external services.
  • Strong experience in developing, customizing, and maintaining WordPress plugins.
  • Experience with custom theme development and WordPress theme architecture.
  • Knowledge of Git, version control best practices, and deployment processes.
  • Understanding of website security, performance optimization, caching mechanisms, and scalability considerations.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Coveo Search Integration.
  • Exposure to WooCommerce and custom eCommerce solutions.
  • Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience working with headless WordPress implementations and API-driven architectures.

raw.description:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing

We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors. Our QA practice has been rebuilt around agentic AI: test planning, test code, failure triage, and even code review happens in partnership with AI coding agents, with the engineer as the human in the loop. We're looking for an SDET to join that team. Judgment, curiosity, and clear writing matter more to us than a perfect CV — if you're strong, we're flexible on the rest.

What the role actually is

You won't spend your days hand-writing boilerplate test scripts. You'll direct AI agents to do the mechanical work, and your job is everything the machine can't be trusted with deciding what's worth testing, checking that a generated test can genuinely fail, spotting when a "passing" suite is lying, and judging whether a red run is a product bug, an environment problem, or a broken test.

What you'll do

  • Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform.
  • Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships.
  • Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on.
  • Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect.
  • Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast, and trustworthy.
  • Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling.
  • Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use.
  • Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development — typically 3–6 years, though we're flexible for the right person.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly.
  • A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication.
  • Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how.
  • Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity.
  • Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't.
  • Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all:
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium).
  • Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one.
  • Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts.
  • WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain.

Nice to have

  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).

raw.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst to shape how we manage credit for our existing customers, reporting to the Senior Director, Portfolio Management.

The impact you'll make:

For a lot of our customers, getting their Mission Lane credit card is the first step toward building their credit. But what comes next is where the real progress happens: earning a higher credit line or a better rate, or qualifying for a second card.

As a Principal Business Analyst, you design the strategy that decides who's ready for that next step, and what it should look like. The skill is building criteria that read how someone's managed what they already have, then account for how a change like that would ripple through the rest of their account. Get that right, and more people keep moving forward toward their goals.

Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.

As Principal Business Analyst, you will:

  • Lead efforts to decide who qualifies for more credit, a second card, or better terms, and how we make those calls
  • Use AI-driven tools to speed up and sharpen your analysis
  • Adjust our approach as customer behavior and the market change
  • Turn financial data into clear recommendations that grow the business while managing risk responsibly
  • Run small tests in market, then use what you learn to decide where we invest next
  • Work with product, data science, engineering, and capital markets to bring your ideas to life
  • Share your strategy and results directly with senior leadership

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You understand the whole card business system, from acquisition to risk to engagement, and you can trace how a change in one part ripples through the rest.
  • You're curious enough to dig into the reasoning behind your own analysis, down to the assumptions it's built on, so you understand it at an elemental level
  • You take ownership of your work end to end, catching your own mistakes before they compound.
  • You can explain a business problem clearly enough that someone outside your immediate team could follow your thinking.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a similarly quantitative field, with a strong academic record
  • A track record of solving open-ended business problems: framing the question, forming a hypothesis, working through the data, and defending your recommendation to stakeholders
  • Comfort working in SQL, Python, or similar tools for data analysis
  • Ability to travel ~4-6+ times per year for high quality in-person collaboration

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with credit cards or other consumer lending products
  • Experience helping scale a business in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Strong SQL or Python skills
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, etc.)

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $118,000-$135,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

Application Integrity:

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

About Yembo

Yembo is a fully remote company on a mission to bring trust and transparency to the home services industry. Our AI technology transforms smartphone videos into virtual surveys enabling workflow specific deliverables for businesses in the Moving & Storage and P&C Insurance space.

With over 100 million properties in the U.S. alone, and millions of inspections required every year for moving, insurance, mortgage, and renovation, Yembo is building the category-defining platform that virtualizes property inspections across industries.

About the role

Yembo is looking for an Operations Manager (IC3) who is hands-on and execution-focused. You’ll be responsible for driving quality, performance, and consistency across day-to-day operations. This role is well suited for someone who has experience working in complex, distributed environments and understands what it takes to maintain high standards as operations scale.

In this role, you will analyze operational and quality data, assess performance against defined SLAs, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes. You will work closely with vendors and internal partners to review performance, align on expectations and support continuous improvement efforts. Success in this position requires strong analytical judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to translate data into practical actions that improve quality, reliability, and customer outcomes over time.

What you'll do

  • Own SLA and performance tracking across vendors and operational workflows, ensuring expectations are clearly designed, measured and monitored.
  • Analyze quality, performance and operational data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop data-backed recommendations for operational changes and best practices, and take ownership of implementing approved improvements.
  • Serve as the operational escalation point for performance and quality issues, partnering cross-functionally to investigate root causes and drive resolution.
  • Work directly with vendors to review performance and support improvements, including enabling adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and SOPs through documentation, guidance and training.
  • Design, document and maintain evergreen training materials, SOPs and best practices for quality teams and vendors.

raw.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Make your actuarial expertise visible where it matters most.

Nationwide Financial is seeking an Actuary to help shape life insurance assumptions that inform pricing, product strategy, risk management, and business decisions. In this high-impact role, you’ll own meaningful experience-study work from data through recommendation, partner with actuarial leaders and the assumption council, and translate complex analysis into clear actions.

This is an opportunity to combine rigorous actuarial analysis with business influence, modern data practices, and practical innovation. You’ll join a collaborative team that values sound judgment, continuous improvement, and a healthy balance between established processes and new ideas.

What you’ll own

  • Lead life insurance experience studies and assumption-setting activities, including data analysis, controls, documentation, interpretation, and recommendations.

  • Take ownership of a major life assumption through the annual assumption unlock cycle, with support and oversight from experienced team members.

  • Present recommendations to the assumption council and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Investigate experience trends and help identify opportunities to support pricing, product decisions, risk analysis, and business growth.

  • Build, maintain, and improve actuarial models, testing tools, data processes, and reporting solutions.

  • Partner with actuarial, finance, product, technology, and other business teams to develop new processes and strengthen existing ones.

  • Help advance responsible AI use in actuarial work, including data transformation, documentation, control testing, quality checks, and analysis support.

What makes this opportunity different

  • Business impact: Your recommendations will help shape assumptions and decisions across Nationwide Financial’s life insurance business.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’ll move beyond producing analysis to investigating the story in the data, applying judgment, and influencing the recommendation.

  • Modern actuarial practice: The team is actively improving data structures, automation, controls, visualization, and responsible AI-enabled workflows.

  • Work-life balance: Choose a fully remote work arrangement or work from Nationwide’s Columbus, Ohio headquarters.

What you’ll bring

  • FSA credential, or progress toward FSA with the experience and judgment to perform at the appropriate level.

  • Approximately seven or more years of actuarial experience, or an equivalent combination of actuarial education and relevant experience.

  • Strong experience with actuarial analysis, statistical methods, data interpretation, modeling, and assumption development.

  • The ability to make thoughtful decisions when data is incomplete, ambiguous, or evolving.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting recommendations in one-on-one and group settings.

  • Experience with SQL, Excel, VBA, Access, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable actuarial, analytical, and data-visualization tools.

  • Life insurance experience is valuable but not required. Experience with universal life, secondary guarantees, or related life products is a plus.

  • A collaborative, curious, and adaptable approach, with the ability to work independently and build strong partnerships across the organization.

If you enjoy turning experience data into decisions, communicating actuarial insight with influence, and helping modernize how actuarial work gets done, we’d like to hear from you.

Job Description Summary

Our Nationwide Financial Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As an Actuary, you’ll show a mastery of business operations, systems and actuarial methodologies. You will provide leadership, direction and oversight for the performance of sophisticated actuarial techniques and procedures and risk analysis. In addition, you’ll develop a strategic vision for the team to ensure efficient, consistent and integrated data and analysis. We’ll count on you to provide business recommendations that are crucial to the success of Nationwide and the protection we provide our customers. You’ll need to work independently and may directly or indirectly lead others.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a specialist for compilation, categorization and analysis of data.

  • Constructs sophisticated testing tools and product calculations.

  • Builds, maintains and computes Actuarial, Projection & Valuation Models.

  • Conducts financial reporting and analysis.

  • Prices and supports implementation of products.

  • Conducts risk analysis for lines of business/products.

  • Establishes reserves and other valuation items under multiple accounting regimes (statutory, GAAP, and tax) for products.

  • Leads and provides experienced knowledge for the analysis of reinsurance opportunities.

  • Builds cohesive presentations, communication strategies and recommendations of actuarial findings that are suitable for technical and non-technical audiences at the OCFO leadership level.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Actuarial leader.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or similar background requiring modeling, programming or quantitative analysis.

License/Certification/Designation: FSA required. PLEASE REFER TO THE NATIONWIDE LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY ACTUARIAL DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

Experience: Typically, five to seven years of actuarial experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Experienced knowledge of actuarial business functions, statistical methods of analysis, actuarial models, actuarial software and databases. Mastery of Microsoft Office products (including VBA within Access and Excel), analytical software (such as tableau) and programming languages. Basic level of organizational agility and conflict management. Proficient level of command skills, strategic agility, delegation, motivating others, business perspective, and accounting. Mastery level of perspective, problem solving, customer focus, dealing with ambiguity, drive for results, analysis, learning.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not eligible)

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Safety AI builds the ML and computer vision systems behind Samsara's AI dash cameras which enable real-time driver alerts, risk signals, and coaching insights running on millions of edge devices and the cloud.

This role owns what happens after training: building the resilient, low-latency ML backend systems that turn static model artifacts into high-throughput, cloud-scale safety features.

You will partner closely with applied scientists, firmware and full-stack engineers, and product managers and you will build the ML APIs, data pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure that let Safety AI models run efficiently at fleet scale, closing the loop from initial integration through rollout monitoring and iteration to a trustworthy, customer-facing signal.

This is ML engineering where the stakes are real: rare, high-consequence events, millions of vehicles, and a product where "it works" means someone got home safely. Kindly refer to this video.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US or Canada.

Technical Charter and Impact:

  • Own the cloud-side path from model artifact to production system for Safety AI's ML applications.
  • Establish practical standards for productionizing models — how they're served, evaluated, versioned, and monitored once they leave applied science.
  • Set a high bar for reliability: rigorous evaluation, measurable rollout health, and systems that degrade predictably rather than silently.
  • Act as a technical partner to applied scientists, helping translate research outputs into systems that are debuggable, scalable, and cost-efficient in production.

In this role, you will:

  • Design Production ML APIs: Architect and maintain reliable, low-latency APIs to integrate Safety AI model outputs directly into cloud applications.
  • Build Data Flywheels: Construct scalable pipelines to power continuous model iteration, backtesting, shadow and online evaluation, enabling fast and safe deployments.
  • Optimize & Serve Artifacts: Productionize model artifacts handed off by applied scientists, optimizing serving logic and fine-tuning models for platform-specific workloads.
  • Petabyte-Scale Operations: Process high-volume camera and sensor telematics data to support model execution, backtesting, and automated dataset curation.
  • Monitor & Maintain Rollout Health: Build systems to track model drift, precision/recall, and latency regressions in production, ensuring predictable failure modes and closed-loop data feedback.
  • Cross-Functional System Integration: Partner with firmware and platform teams to optimize edge-to-cloud model execution, balancing latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
  • Product Collaboration: Work with product managers to translate safety requirements into scalable technical architectures.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, with a track record of shipping models in production.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more common languages (e.g., C++, Golang, Java, Python, Scala).
  • Proficiency with common ML tools (e.g. Ray/Ray Serve, MLflow, Grafana, Pytorch, Spark, etc).
  • Experience deploying and iteratively refining models using real customer feedback loops.
  • Comfort with full-stack/backend development — you understand the data structures and dependencies underneath your models.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related quantitative field.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science or a quantitative discipline (e.g., Applied Math, Physics, Statistics).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
  • Experience deploying and managing ML applications in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), including cloud-based storage, processing, and inference.
  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML applications from artifact to production, ideally in safety-critical or high-scale domains.
  • Expertise optimizing distributed model training with GPUs.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$170,170—$286,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: [8NW] Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Focused)
raw.excerpt: Overview Software Mind is seeking qualified candidates to fill the role of Senior Backend / Data Engineer.
raw.description:
Overview
Software Mind is seeking qualified candidates to fill the role of Senior Backend / Data Engineer.

In addition to a competitive salary rate and a positive work environment, we are committed to delivering high-quality technology solutions. We also offer:

  • Flexible schedules and authentic work-life balance
  • Opportunities for continuing education
  • Birthday celebration
  • Payment in US Dollars

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend focused) to help design, build, and operate scalable backend systems that support core business workflows and data-driven products.

This is a primarily backend-focused role (~70%), with a smaller front-end component (~30%) working within an HTML/HTMX-based stack. Deep front-end expertise is not required, but candidates should be comfortable picking up front-end development when needed.

The role combines hands-on development with ownership of critical services and collaboration across product, data, and operations teams. You will contribute to system architecture, code quality, reliability, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

You will work hands-on with technologies including Python, SQL, AWS, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Snowflake, Docker, Kubernetes, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and microservices architecture. The environment also includes data pipelines and orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.

Some of the main responsibilities for the role include:

  • Design and implement reliable, scalable backend services and data pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain backend applications primarily using Python and SQL.
  • Drive engineering best practices around testing, code quality, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Improve system observability and participate in diagnosing and resolving production issues.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion services using APIs and batch file processing.
  • Modernize legacy workflows by replacing manual or spreadsheet-driven processes with automated and resilient systems.
  • Develop internal dashboards and services that provide real-time operational and business visibility.
  • Create automation to reduce manual investigation and enable self-service for internal stakeholders.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks across backend pipelines.
  • Collaborate with product, analytics, and operations teams to align technical solutions with business needs.
  • Contribute to technical direction, architecture decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Contribute to the application's front-end layer (~30% of the role) using technologies such as HTML, HTMX, Jinja templates, and Python-based rendering.

Job Skills/Requirements

  • +90% English written and oral (at least B2-C1 level) with excellent communication skills.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in backend development.
  • Strong backend engineering background with the ability to deliver pragmatic and iterative technical solutions.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Ability to independently own technical work and lead technical efforts across teams.
  • Willingness to take ownership, learn from failures, and continuously improve systems and processes

Technical Skills:

Backend / Programming

  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Strong proficiency in SQL
  • Experience designing and developing production backend services

    Databases & Data
  • Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, with PostgreSQL preferred
  • Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse
  • Experience working with data ingestion, processing, and data-driven applications

    Cloud
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on AWS

    DevOps
  • Experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK, or similar tools
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and production deployments

    Architecture
  • Experience designing scalable, reliable, high-performance distributed systems
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture
  • Strong API design experience, including REST APIs and/or GraphQL
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and secure service design
  • Experience with unit and integration testing

    Front-End (Highly Desired)
  • HTML
  • HTMX
  • Jinja templates
  • Using Python for front-end/server-rendered application development

    Deep expertise in a traditional JavaScript frontend framework is not required.

Nice to have Skills (not required):

  • Experience with Apache Airflow or another data pipeline/orchestration platform
  • Experience with frontend frameworks or languages such as React, Next.js, Angular, or JavaScript

We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!

raw.title: Account Manager, ACOs & Medicare Supplement (MediGap) Health Plans
raw.excerpt: About Ceresti Health Ceresti Health exists because dementia doesn’t just happen to a person — it happens to a family.
raw.description:
About Ceresti Health

Ceresti Health exists because dementia doesn’t just happen to a person — it happens to a family. We’ve built the first national, technology-enabled program that puts family caregivers at the center of dementia care, and we’re one of a small number of organizations selected by CMS to participate in the GUIDE Model. That’s not a credential. It’s a mandate. We’re building the infrastructure to transform how this country cares for people living with dementia — and the Account Manager position for ACOs & Med Supp plans is one of the most important roles in making that real.

Ceresti Health is a tech-enabled dementia care provider pioneering a differentiated model of care to activates family caregivers by giving them the knowledge, skills, and confident to detect an early change in their loved one’s condition. As one of the organizations selected by CMS to participatein the GUIDE Model and almost a decade of experience working in Medicare Advantage populations, we’re at the forefront of transforming dementia care nationwide.

Position Overview

The Account Manager, ACOs & MediGap is a high-ownership, relationship-intensive role at the intersection of performance management, physician awareness and education, carrier relationship development, and organizational change. You will serve as the primary partner for ACOs and Medicare Supplement carriers partnering with Ceresti — helping both ACOs and MediGap carriers strategically leverage the GUIDE Model to impact one of the costliest, most unmanaged cohorts in their populations. The Account Manager is responsible not just for account health, but for building the kind of trust that allows Ceresti to proactively enroll eligible beneficiaries on behalf of partner ACOs and MediGap plans.

This is not a reactive account management role. ACOs are complex organizations with physician stakeholders who are protective of their patient relationships, operational teams managing competing priorities, and leadership who need to see ROI in shared savings and operational relief. MediGapcarriers bring a different but equally complex dynamic — product and actuarial teams evaluating clinical value, compliance teams navigating CMS requirements, and member services teams that need seamless integration with GUIDE Model workflows. Your job is to earn and maintain trust across both channels — and to translate that trust into enrollment performance, program adoption, and measurable outcomes.

You’ll succeed here if you’re energized by complexity, comfortable navigating physician skepticism and carrier procurement cycles, and deeply motivated by what it means to get this right for families living with dementia.

Key Responsibilities

ACO & MediGap Carrier Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary account owner for assigned ACO and MediGap carrier partners from post-implementation through steady state.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with ACO leadership, operations teams, clinical leaders, and care management staff, as well as MediGap carrier product, compliance, and member services teams.
  • Understand all components of the GUIDE Model and communicate GUIDE workflows to ACO care teams. For MediGap partners, understand how the GUIDE Model applies within the MediGap context and help carriers operationalize Ceresti's program for their member populations.
  • Act as an internal liaison at Ceresti for each partner (ACO or MediGap carrier), ensuring the partner’s needs, constraints, and priorities are clearly understood, communicated, and appropriately addressed.
  • Support contract adherence, shared savings alignment (ACOs), GUIDE Model performance targets (MediGap carriers), and ongoing partnership health.

Program Performance & Growth

  • Own enrollment performance for assigned ACOs and MediGap carriers, including monitoring physician/care team referral flow (ACOs), member outreach and program utilization (MediGap), outreach effectiveness, and caregiver activation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve uptake through provider education, workflow refinement, targeted engagement strategies, and — for MediGap partners — carrier marketing integration and member communications.
  • Partner with internal teams to troubleshoot enrollment barriers and optimize operational processes.
  • Support discussions around performance results, savings, and opportunities for expansion.

Provider, Care Team & Carrier Enablement

  • Drive physician awareness and buy-in across assigned ACO networks — including direct engagement with PCPs, care managers, and practice staff to establish Ceresti’s model as a trusted complement to existing care teams, not a competing intervention. For MediGap partners, enable carrier member services teams to support GUIDE Model enrollment and workflows for their members.
  • Coordinate patient-facing, provider-facing, and carrier-facing materials, training, and communications in collaboration with Marketing & Engagement teams.
  • Ensure providers understand Ceresti’s caregiver-centric approach and how it complements—not replaces—existing care management teams and efforts.

Proactive Enrollment Stewardship

  • Build and maintain the trust and governance alignment required for Ceresti to conduct proactive outreach to eligible beneficiaries on behalf of partner ACOs and MediGap carriers. For ACOs, this means physician-level alignment; for MediGap carriers, this means carrier-approved member outreach and GUIDE Model enrollment workflows. Own the internal and external approvals, workflows, and communication protocols that make proactive enrollment operationally viable and clinically credible across both channels.

Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with Implementation, GUIDE Coordinators, Coaching, and Operations teams to ensure smooth ongoing operations across ACO and MediGap accounts.
  • Support data-sharing workflows, CCLF data file refreshes (ACOs), carrier eligibility file exchanges (MediGap), and outreach approvals in alignment with ACO governance and carrier compliance requirements.
  • Monitor operational SLAs, outreach cadence, and member experience to ensure a high-quality, compliant program.

Reporting & Communication

  • Lead recurring partner check-ins and business reviews with assigned ACOs and MediGap carriers.
  • Deliver clear, data-driven updates on enrollment, engagement, outcomes, and operational performance.
  • Translate complex data into concise, executive-ready insights for ACO and MediGap carrier stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in account management, client success, provider relations, carrier/payer relations, or partnership management within healthcare.
  • Experience working with ACOs, Medicare Advantage plans, Medicare Supplement (MediGap) carriers, or value-based care organizations. Direct experience with MediGap carriers, CMS care model delivery, or carrier product and operations teams is strongly valued.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare operations, provider workflows, and population health models.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships.
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and follow-through skills.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CMS models (e.g. GUIDE, MSSP, ACO REACH, or other value-based programs).
  • Familiarity with caregiver support, dementia care, home care, or care management models.
  • Experience managing carrier or health plan accounts, including CMS model implementation, member engagement, or GUIDE-adjacent program delivery.
  • Experience presenting performance data and outcomes to executive audiences.
  • Comfort working in a high-growth, fast-moving startup environment.
  • Experience with HubSpot is a plus

What You’re Walking Into

  • A role with real ownership — you’ll have named ACO and National MediGap carrier accounts, clear performance metrics, and direct visibility to senior leadership
  • A CMS GUIDE Model that is early-stage nationally, and a MediGap channel that is greenfield — which means your work shapes how this program scales across both channels nationwide
  • A team that’s deeply mission-aligned and operationally serious — we move fast, but we don’t cut corners on compliance or quality
  • Competitive compensation, full benefits, and a remote-first environment built for people who deliver without being managed

Why Ceresti?

Ceresti Health is redefining how caregivers of people living with dementia are supported—at scale. Our national, tech-enabled, caregiver-centric, and risk-bearing model delivers meaningful cost savings while dramatically improving caregiver and patient outcomes. Joining Ceresti means playing a direct role in expanding access to high-impact support for families who need it most.

Salary: $100,000 – $110,000 / year

The Legal Assistant will be a detail-oriented and proactive support to our Legal team, with a particular focus on contract management, legal operations, mergers & acquisitions (M&A) support and administrative support. This role works closely with the Associate General Counsel to help manage the contract lifecycle, assist with legal operations, administrative items, and maintain the organization and integrity of legal records. The ideal candidate is highly organized, enthusiastic, discreet with confidential information, and comfortable working in a fast-paced legal environment.

Responsibilities

    Contract Support

    • Assist in overseeing the contract lifecycle management (CLM) system, including intake, routing, execution, and archiving or agreements
    • Maintain accurate records, report contract metrics and track contractual terms.
    • Provide initial review and coordinate the redlining and review process of contracts between internal stakeholder and counterparties.
    • Assist with contract drafting and processing, including formatting, clean-up, filing and execution of agreements.
    • Maintain an organized repository of executed contracts, templates, and playbooks.

      • M&A Support

    • Assist the Associate General Counsel and deal team with due diligence coordination, including organizing and reviewing virtual data rooms.
    • Prepare and maintain due diligence checklists, closing checklists, and signature pages.
    • Track and compile disclosure schedules, ancillary documents, and closing deliverables.
    • Assist with post-closing integration tasks, including entity records updates and contract assignments.
    • Maintain organized deal files and ensure accurate recordkeeping throughout the transaction lifecycle.

      • General Legal Operations and Administrative Support

    • Assist in overseeing the administration of the company’s legal billing platform and interact with all levels of the organization and departments to ensure the payment of, and efficient forecasting of legal invoices.
    • Assist in the accrual of legal expenses and lead the interaction related thereto between the Legal and Finance departments.
    • Assist the team in various stages of litigation record keeping.
    • Work with other members of the legal team to drive progress on cross-functional projects, as assigned, while looking for opportunities to improve processes to help the company scale and be more efficient.
    • Respond to requests for information as needed, including assisting company personnel with information or data from the legal department and assisting outside counsel and others as required.
    • Administrative duties including but not limited to overseeing books and records and contract repository.
    • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a legal assistant in a law firm or corporate legal department preferred.
  • At least 1 year of experience in contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  • Prior legal operations and billing experience preferred.
  • Prior legal project management experience preferred.
  • Experience utilizing AI to streamline various responsibilities.
  • Organization and legal project management skills.
  • Excellent business judgment, critical thinking, and communication skills.
  • Action oriented with demonstrated project management skills.
  • Flexibility and willingness to work on a broad variety of matters.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills, capable of handling multiple requests in a fast-paced environment and managing priorities efficiently.
  • Strong computer and word processing skills, including proficiency with Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, e-billing platforms, and contract management tools.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively work with staff at all levels of the organization.
  • Background Check Required

raw.description:
Working at CreateFutureCreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

Our UK Benefits

  • 35 days leave (including bank holidays).
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Enhanced parental and adoption leave.
  • Financial coaching + 5% pension match.
  • 40 hours of paid learning and development.

View our full list of UK benefits. CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

At CreateFuture, our Lead Engineer - Cloud plays a pivotal role in supporting the success of our Cloud engineers, our clients, and internal projects. Working closely with clients, you are responsible for the successful delivery of client and internal projects by building professional relationships with key client stakeholders, challenging where appropriate. Use your technical expertise to provide best practice advice and processes within your project team and the wider capability.

As our client demands expand from traditional cloud migrations to AI enablement and platform engineering, you will lead the charge in building autonomous platforms, managing AI lifecycles, and enforcing strict cost governance across cloud estates. You are seen as a leader internally and externally, through your technical expertise, guidance, and professionalism, both on and off a client. Alongside delivering for your customers, you will also support and mentor a team of cloud engineers to encourage their growth. You will be setting the technical direction of the team alongside Cloud Leads and Senior Engineers.

Key responsibilities:

Consultancy & Advisory

  • Growth Mindset: Apply a growth mindset to identify new revenue opportunities on client accounts, working alongside the commercial team to successfully land additional work.
  • Pre-Sales Contribution: Lead and contribute to pre-sales activities, RFPs, and BIDs, accounting for up to 5% to 10% of the role. Engage with the commercial team to drive high-value Cloud and Data advisory roles.
  • Ambassadorial Presence: Act as an ambassador for CreateFuture in the public space, attending events, speaking, blogging, or leveraging social media to support the growth of the Cloud capability.
  • Hands-on: you are an experienced engineer and can be active with the cloud platform tools, software development and writing efficient code for clients.

Technical Leadership & Platform Support

  • Technical Direction: Take responsibility for the technical direction and delivery of single or multiple client and internal project teams, acting as either a technical lead or a solo contributor.
  • AI-Native Infrastructure: Architect and implement the core engineering infrastructure required to run AI workloads reliably, moving client architectures from static data lakes to dynamic Vector Databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Agentic Development: Build production-grade Agentic Workflows and custom AI agents, utilising advanced toolsets to bridge the widening market implementation gap.
  • Setting Development Best Practices: Define, promote, and establish best practice tools, security approaches, and common service patterns across the entire CreateFuture organisation. Ensure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is the organisational default and challenge inefficient legacy processes.
  • FinOps & Governance: Enforce strict automated security and cost controls, real-time cost-anomaly detection, and cost estimation into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) as a standard. Understanding of OpenTelemetry or other telemetry approaches.
  • Internal Platform Support: Assist the Capability Lead and architects in defining and delivering an internal collection of reusable components, reference architectures, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs). Supporting the internal IT function in helping other parts of the business use Cloud services.

Leading & Mentoring

  • Culture & Collaboration: Lead by example, creating a culture of open, honest feedback, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.
  • People Development: Create a psychologically safe environment for the team that enables them to grow by supporting their development journeys and career aspirations.
  • Capability Growth: Work alongside the Capability Lead and Director of Cloud and Data to identify missing or inconsistent skills within the department, supporting team members through tiered certification journeys.
  • Recruitment: Collaborate with Talent Acquisition through the recruitment process, including conducting interviews, candidate debriefs, and strategic decision-making to attract top talent.

Skills & Experience

Core Technical Capabilities

Candidates must demonstrate a hybrid skillset, balancing Software Engineering (30%), Platform/SRE (40%), and Data Engineering (30%), with a core focus on Security, Governance, and Cost Management.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure (40%): Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via Terraform, advanced Kubernetes administration (clusters, nodes, pods), hardcore networking (VPC peering, Service Mesh, Zero Trust security), and solution architecture experience, with a cost-optimisation mindset.
  • Software Engineering, Agentic & AI Development (30%): Solid software engineer principles (pipelines, toolsets, testing, linting, vulnerability scanning, etc.) Production-level experience with tools such as Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, and writing automation scripts or custom AI agents using node or python.
  • Data Engineering (30%): Experience deploying and maintaining data orchestration toolsets (e.g., dbt, Apache Airflow), ETL/ELT methodologies, real-time streaming (e.g., AWS Kinesis, Apache Kafka), Vector databases, and RAG architectures.
  • Observability & FinOps: Experience implementing modern observability tooling (OpenTelemetry) alongside automated cost-control systems (such as Karpenter, Infracost, OpenCost, or Cloud Custodian).

Domain & Sector Experience

  • Regulated Industries: Experience working in highly regulated sectors such as Financial Services or iGaming is helpful, demonstrating an understanding of strict compliance, data privacy risks, and governance guardrails.
  • Consulting: Proven background in a client-facing consulting capacity, managing stakeholders, handling commercial realities, and meeting strict SLAs, timescales, and budgets.

Senior Business Analyst
Location: US Remote
Preferred Location: Candidates located in Illinois or surrounding states are strongly preferred.

Ready to make a difference?
Working at ICF means applying your passion for meaningful work and intellectual rigor to help solve some of today’s most important challenges. Our employees are smart, compassionate, innovative, and committed, and they work together to serve people, businesses, and governments around the world. We value collaboration, mutual respect, open communication, and opportunities for growth.

We are seeking a versatile Senior Business Analyst who can independently lead small to mid-sized projects and complex workstreams from concept through delivery. This role requires a strong combination of analytical thinking, business acumen, technical curiosity, and delivery discipline, along with the ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear, actionable solutions. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, quick learner, and collaborative partner who can facilitate decisions, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across business stakeholders, engineering teams, and clients to deliver high-quality results.

The Senior Business Analyst supports work across the software development lifecycle, translating business needs and system data into effective technology solutions and meaningful business intelligence. This role contributes to IT projects supporting energy efficiency initiatives, leads requirements and process-improvement activities, and partners closely with ICF subject matter experts, delivery teams, and clients to execute project objectives.

You may be required to participate in periodic drug testing and background checks. 

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

 

What you will be doing:

  • Support all phases of the software development lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, testing, implementation, and post-launch validation for tools that support energy efficiency program tracking and reporting.
  • Independently lead requirements and analysis workstreams, facilitating workshops and stakeholder discussions to clarify objectives, resolve ambiguity, document decisions, and drive work toward delivery.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes and recommend technology-enabled improvements by identifying risks, gaps, dependencies, issues, controls, and automation opportunities.
  • Translate business needs into structured project plans, requirements specifications, process flows, data mappings, use cases, acceptance criteria, and actionable user stories.
  • Collaborate with senior technologists, developers, reporting teams, project managers, and other cross-functional partners to deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Analyze datasets using Excel, SQL, Power BI, or related tools to identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and business insights; validate data quality and recommend practical actions.
  • Proactively track risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, dependencies, milestones, and action items; communicate impacts and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Develop clear system and process documentation and support end users through training, knowledge transfer, and individualized technical assistance.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to other analysts, share effective practices, and contribute to consistent, audit-ready delivery standards.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications): 

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, computer science, or a related field (applicants can substitute one year of related experience for one year of education)
  • 5+ years of experience working in a Business Analyst or similar role supporting data-driven or technical systems, with a focus on requirements gathering, stakeholder collaboration, and translating business needs into technical solutions
  • 2+ years of experience prioritizing multiple projects to meet goals, deliverables, and time sensitive assignments and deadlines
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel skills
  • Must be able to pass a background check drug screening.

What we would like you to have:

  • Experience in or exposure to the utility, energy, demand response, and/or energy efficiency sectors.
  • Experience with issue tracking, collaboration, and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Visio, or MS Project.
  • Strong customer service orientation, project planning capability, organizational skills, and ability to balance multiple projects, deliverables, and deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to business audiences and business needs to technical teams, while constructively challenging assumptions and building alignment.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work in an environment with evolving requirements.
  • Strong requirements elicitation, workshop facilitation, process analysis, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

At Pandoblox, the Data Project Manager plays a central role in coordinating both client and internal projects, with particular emphasis on data-centric engagements — including data architecture, migration, ETL/pipeline builds, and BI/dashboarding delivery. This role sits at the intersection of structured project delivery and technical data work, requiring someone who can speak fluently to data architects and engineers while still owning the project plan, budget, and client communication. You will manage multiple concurrent projects in a well-organized, efficient, and professional manner, acting as a primary liaison between the Organization's delivery teams and its client stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you'll get to...

  • manage the people, tasks, and external resources for assigned data projects within the defined tolerances
  • ensure the project team is defined and staffed appropriately, and that the appropriate internal and external services (data engineers, architects, analysts) are obtained to meet project objectives
  • coordinate data architecture, migration, and ETL/pipeline workstreams, translating technical scope into a clear project plan and timeline
  • support the delivery of BI/dashboarding engagements alongside data infrastructure work, coordinating between engineering, design, and client stakeholders
  • comply with all System Development/Project Life Cycle, Change Management, Regulatory, and applicable data privacy/security requirements
  • provide oversight of the analysis, development, implementation, and maintenance of data systems and applications
  • communicate with users, IT, and senior-level management concerning project progress, concerns, and issues, and manage stakeholders' expectations
  • ensure all project requirements and/or objectives — including data quality, validation, and governance checkpoints — are properly defined and documented
  • establish, build, and update project plans with actuals and forecasts; manage deviations from the plan and identify and manage project risk
  • act as a primary liaison between the data/engineering division and the various stakeholders
  • maintain project and task tracking in the Organization's core PM tools (e.g., ClickUp for tasks, Harvest/Forecast for time-tracking and burndown reporting)
  • express information effectively through clear and convincing oral and written presentations, including translating technical data concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • perform other duties as needed by the role

REQUIREMENTS:

On day one, we'll expect you to...

  • have a bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience
  • have a minimum of 5 years of Project Management experience, including exposure to data, analytics, or BI/dashboarding engagements
  • possess solid knowledge of project management frameworks, tools, and practices
  • have working knowledge of data architecture, ETL/pipeline concepts, and data warehouse or migration project fundamentals — enough to scope, sequence, and de-risk technical workstreams
  • have exposure to SQL and relational databases sufficient to understand data models and ask informed technical questions
  • have familiarity with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar) from a delivery-coordination standpoint
  • be comfortable working in ClickUp (or a comparable task-tracking tool) and Harvest/Forecast (or a comparable time-tracking and forecasting platform)
  • be experienced in project budgeting, design, scheduling, and documentation
  • have good business analysis skills
  • have excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • have strong management skills and the ability to lead and motivate project teams
  • demonstrate the ability to build and manage relationships with customers and all stakeholders across business units
  • be experienced in supervising a matrix team of associates, contractors, and vendors with various skills and disciplines
  • have the ability to coordinate/participate on multiple projects in a well-organized, efficient, and professional manner
  • be able to work independently, multi-task, and prioritize responsibilities, leveraging time management and problem-solving skills to perform assigned tasks with reasonable levels of self-direction
  • have keen attention to detail and focus on task completion, particularly around data accuracy and validation
  • have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties
  • be willing to install next-generation endpoint protection on the computer
  • be a current resident of the Philippines and able to perform work from there
  • be willing to work within US Pacific business hours (8am–5pm PT, which corresponds to Philippine hours per the Organization's seasonal schedule)

What separate the best from the rest...

  • multiple industry exposure
  • PMP certification
  • agile experience and certification
  • Six Sigma certification
  • experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
  • prior hands-on data engineering or data analyst background before moving into project management
  • experience with data governance frameworks and data privacy/compliance considerations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
  • experience delivering dashboarding/observability engagements
  • experience supporting both waterfall data projects (e.g., migrations, assessments) and recurring/managed data services within the same portfolio

NOTES:

  • Benefits await full-time contractors.
  • This is a remote (work from home) position.
